title: Quality Engineer
description:
**Project Role :** Quality Engineer  
**Project Role Description :** Enables full stack solutions through multi-disciplinary team planning and ecosystem integration to accelerate delivery and drive quality across the application lifecycle. Performs continuous testing for security, API, and regression suite. Creates automation strategy, automated scripts and supports data and environment configuration. Participates in code reviews, monitors, and reports defects to support continuous improvement activities for the end-to-end testing process.
  
**Must have skills :** Java Full Stack Development  
**Good to have skills :** Spring Boot  
Minimum **3** year(s) of experience is required  
**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  
  
Role Summary  
We are seeking a hands-on Engineering Manager who leads from the trenches — writing production-grade code daily while simultaneously driving team delivery and technical strategy. This is not a purely supervisory role. You will be an active contributor to Java Spring Boot backend services, React frontends, and API development, while managing a team of engineers and owning end-to-end delivery. The ideal candidate is a strong individual contributor who has grown into leadership without stepping away from the keyboard.  
Key Responsibilities  
  
Hands-On Technical Contribution  
Independently design, develop, and ship full stack features using Java Spring Boot (backend) and React (frontend) with minimal direction.  
Architect and build RESTful APIs and microservices from scratch, owning the full lifecycle from design through deployment.  
Write complex Oracle SQL queries, manage schema design, performance tuning, and indexing strategies directly.  
Personally contribute to CI/CD pipeline setup, containerization, and OpenShift deployment — not just review others' work.  
Debug, optimize, and refactor production code to meet performance and scalability standards.  
Actively use and champion AI development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) as a daily part of your own engineering workflow.  
  
Technical Leadership  
Set architectural direction and make independent technical decisions on system design, API contracts, and data modeling.  
Conduct meaningful code reviews rooted in your own current coding experience, not just managerial instinct.  
Define and enforce engineering standards, security practices, and documentation expectations across the team.  
Evaluate and introduce new tools, frameworks, or patterns based on direct hands-on assessment.  
  
Team Management & Delivery:  
Lead a team of engineers through agile ceremonies, sprint planning, and delivery milestones while remaining a committed coder yourself.  
Mentor and grow junior and mid-level engineers through pair programming, code walkthroughs, and real-time technical coaching.  
Collaborate with product managers and stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions — and then build them yourself.  
Manage delivery risk, technical debt, and cross-team dependencies without delegating your own engineering accountability.  
  
Required Qualifications:  
5+ years of hands-on software engineering experience.  
Currently active and proficient in Java Full Stack Development — you write Spring Boot and React code regularly, not just in the past.  
Deep expertise in RESTful API design, microservices architecture, and enterprise integration patterns.  
Strong Oracle Database and SQL skills — query writing, performance tuning, indexing, and data modeling done independently.  
Direct experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git workflows, and containerized deployments.  
Comfortable working independently in ambiguous environments with minimal oversight.  
Bachelor's degree or equivalent (15 years full-time education preferred).  
  
Preferred Qualifications:  
OpenShift or Kubernetes hands-on deployment experience.  
Experience with API security (OAuth2, JWT) and cloud-native design patterns.  
Prior experience as a senior individual contributor who transitioned into a working management role.

  
15 years full time education

title: Principal Engineer, AI Delivery Hub
description:
**Job Title**

Principal Engineer, AI Delivery Hub

**About the Role**
------------------

The Principal Engineer is a technical leader focused on strengthening engineering capabilities, quality, and collaboration across the organization.

Working across multiple teams and technical areas, you will shape and promote engineering standards, development practices, tools, and frameworks that help teams deliver effective, secure, and reliable software. Acting as a catalyst for collaboration and improvement, you’ll enhance developer experience, productivity, software quality, and operational excellence across the AI Delivery Hub.

You bring leadership through expertise and partnership, collaborating with architects, engineering managers, principal engineers, and platform teams to continuously evolve how software is designed, built, tested, and operated.

  

**In this role, you’ll:**
-------------------------

* Develop and refine engineering standards, guidelines, and best practices that support innovation and reliability.
* Promote quality, security, and maintainability across products and services.
* Encourage adoption of modern engineering practices and continuous improvement.
* Collaborate on technical reviews, supporting teams in addressing complex engineering challenges.
* Enhance developer experience through better tools, automation, and process simplification.
* Encourage use of reusable frameworks and shared assets to accelerate development.
* Drive continuous improvement efforts to boost performance, sustainability, and maintainability of systems.
* Align technical direction and engineering strategy in partnership with technical and business leaders.
* Mentor and coach engineers at all levels, creating communities of practice and promoting knowledge sharing.
Foster a culture of collaboration, learning, and inclusive technical excellence.  

  

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Teams deliver with confidence and consistent quality.
* Engineering standards are clearly defined, adopted, and effective across teams.
* Developer experience and productivity improve through better tools and processes.
* System health and sustainability are strengthened through active management of complexity.
* Clear frameworks support autonomy and meaningful coordination.
* Shared expertise scales technical excellence across the organization.
Teams see engineering practices as enablers of innovation and success.  

  

**Your Profile**
----------------

* Strong experience leading impactful software engineering initiatives.
* Deep understanding of software architecture, cloud-native systems, and modern development practices.
* Proven ability to collaborate across multiple teams and contribute to strategic technical direction.
* Experience driving improvements in engineering productivity, quality, and delivery effectiveness.
Strong communication, mentoring, and stakeholder engagement skills with a collaborative mindset.  

  

**What we can offer you**
-------------------------

A truly global DNA - Everything at Amadeus is global, from our people to our business, which translates into our footprint, processes, and culture.
  
Great opportunities to learn - Learning happens all the time and in many ways at Amadeus, through on-the-job training, formal learning activities, and day-to-day interactions with colleagues.
  
A caring environment - Amadeus fosters a caring environment, nurturing both a fulfilling career and personal and family life. We care about our employees and strive to provide a supportive work environment.
  
A hybrid working model - We want our employees to do their best work, however the hybrid model works best for them.
  
A diverse and inclusive community - We are committed to leveraging our uniquely diverse population to drive innovation, creativity, and collaboration across our organization.
  
A Reliable Company - Trust and reliability are fundamental values that drive our actions and shape long-lasting relationships with our customers, partners, and employees.
  
A critical mission and purpose - At Amadeus, you will be powering the future of travel and pursuing a critical mission and extraordinary purpose.

Amadeus is an equal opportunity employer and committed to an accessible recruitment process. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, beliefs, disability or any other characteristics protected by law.

title: Applied AI Architect, Partnerships
description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

As a Partners Solutions Architect on the Applied AI team at Anthropic, you will be a Pre-Sales architect focused on cultivating technical relationships with our Global and Regional System Integrators (GSIs/RSIs), and our cloud partners . You will strengthen our relationships with key partners to accelerate indirect revenue, enable their AI practices, and execute on long-term GTM strategy.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* **Strategic Technical Partnership**: Be a technical thought partner to the Anthropic GTM partnerships team, providing technical expertise to better understand the partner landscape, driving key strategic programs, and identifying opportunities to deepen partner technical capabilities. Embed with GSI and cloud partner technical teams to enable their AI practices, support troubleshooting, evangelize Anthropic in their developer communities, and serve as an escalation point for complex technical issues.
* **Joint Solution Development:** Collaborate with partners to identify high value industry-specific GenAI applications, develop joint solutions and codify reference architectures / best practices to accelerate time to deployment
* **Customer Deal Support:** Intervene directly to unblock strategic customer deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep technical expertise and solution architecture guidance.
* **Partner Ecosystem & Events**: Represent Anthropic at partner events such as GSI customer workshops, summits, and industry conferences. Lead or support partner-specific developer events, hackathons, and technical enablement sessions, especially for technically native communities.
* **Product Feedback:** Validate and gather feedback on Anthropic's products and offerings, especially as they relate to partner use cases and deployment patterns, and deliver this feedback to relevant Anthropic teams to inform product roadmap and partner strategy.

**You may be a good fit if you have:**
--------------------------------------

* 10+ years of experience in technical customer-facing/partner-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner Sales Engineer
* Track record of successfully partnering with GSIs and/or cloud providers to solve complex technical challenges, from initial solution design through customer delivery
* Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C-suite executives, engineering & IT teams, and more
* Strong presentation & technical communication skills with the ability to translate requirements between technical and business stakeholders
* Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems
* Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science
* Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed
* Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems

**Logistics**
-------------

**Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

**Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

**Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

**Location-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

**Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.  
  
**Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

**How we're different**
-----------------------

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

**Come work with us!**
----------------------

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Job Description**

Role purpose
  
Lead a healthy, capable and outcome-owned engineering group that delivers X3 readiness while protecting quality, customer continuity, people development and sustainable delivery capacity.
  
X3 context
  
Sage X3 is the SaaS-readiness programme for X3: a progressive transformation from tightly coupled legacy runtime patterns towards portable, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. The programme protects customer behaviour, partner IP and rollback while it modernises journeys, APIs, components, data paths, business logic, delivery automation and migration economics.
  
The role contributes to outcome-owned squads. India is a scalable engineering and product delivery centre, connected to Europe and North America through deliberate overlap, shared standards, recorded decisions and continuous support of production outcomes.
  
Required technical and domain skills
  
- Experience leading software engineering teams delivering commercial, cloud or ERP products.
  
- Technical fluency across modern backend engineering, SQL/databases, APIs, legacy modernisation, SaaS delivery and automation.
  
- Hands-on experience with containerisation and Kubernetes.
  
- Ability to manage distributed teams, dependencies, hiring, performance, development and difficult conversations.
  
- Comfort with delivery metrics, quality gates, reliability, support economics and evidence-based governance.
  
- Strong English communication and the judgement to balance near-term delivery with long-term capability.
  
Modern platform skills for this role
  
- Use developer and operator feedback, platform adoption, delivery flow, reliability, support effort and cost to guide capacity and improvement. Be fluent in secure delivery, identity, telemetry, lifecycle and rollback decisions for the group; implementation depth and tool use remain with the relevant engineers.
  
Preferred skills
  
- Experience scaling India engineering capacity in a global product organisation.
  
- Hands-on exposure to L4G/4GL, Progress 4GL, Web/Syracuse, data migration or batch processing.
  
- Sage X3/Xtrem and enterprise application language experience.
  
- Cloud platform, migration programmes, partner ecosystems or regulated SaaS.
  
- Formal people leadership qualification or Agile coaching experience.
  
Experience and qualifications
  
Typically 10+ years in software delivery, including 3+ years managing or leading engineering teams. Degree or equivalent experience in engineering, computer science or a related field.
  
Professional English is required for global collaboration. Equivalent practical experience is valued alongside formal qualifications.
  
Expected outcomes / success measures
  
- Squads have named owners, realistic capacity, clear dependencies and a visible path to each evidence gate.
  
- Delivery predictability, quality, retention, engagement and technical capability improve over time.
  
- India delivery owns meaningful outcomes with effective global collaboration rather than serving as a hand-off function.
  
- Customer continuity, supportability and rollback remain protected while modernisation accelerates.
  
\*Measures should be agreed with the squad and reviewed through the X3 monthly scorecard and quarterly evidence gates. For this role’s owned scope, show how customer behaviour and partner investment are preserved, capabilities \*\*become portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable, and quality, reliability, supportability and rollback are proven. Include safe migration and improved cost or delivery economics where relevant.\*
  
Key stakeholders and collaboration model
  
Works with Product Managers, Architects, Principal Engineers, People teams, Programme Management, Security, Cloud Support/L3, Customer Services, partners and senior leadership across regions. Maintains practical Europe/North America overlap for decisions and escalation.
  
Sage behaviours / leadership expectations
  
Customer Focus, Action Orientation, Accountability, Trust, Developing Talent, Innovation and Collaboration. Creates clarity, gives context, removes blockers and holds a high bar with humanity.
  
Every colleague is expected to protect customer continuity, partner investment, security and the integrity of evidence. Leaders additionally create clarity, develop talent and make accountable decisions visible.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

Core accountabilities and decision ownership
  
- Own delivery capacity, staffing, prioritisation flow, quality, dependencies, risk and continuity for one or more multidisciplinary squads.
  
- Create the conditions for engineers, automation specialists, product and architecture partners to deliver measurable outcomes rather than activity.
  
- Hire, onboard, coach, develop and retain talent in India while building effective links with Europe, North America and APAC colleagues.
  
- Run transparent delivery and risk reviews; ensure quarterly evidence gates, monthly scorecards and scope guardrails are respected.
  
- Partner with Architects and Product Managers on sequencing, trade-offs, escalation, operational readiness and customer impact.
  
- Ensure incident learning, support knowledge transfer, security, inclusion and psychological safety are part of normal delivery.
  
Decision ownership:
  
People and capacity decisions, delivery sequencing within mandate, risk escalation, team operating model and readiness recommendations. Escalates material product, architecture, security, legal or commercial decisions with evidence.
  
Common capability baseline
  
All X3 roles are expected to build capability in the following areas. Depth and decision scope increase with level:
  
- Understand X3 customer workflows, metadata, customisation and architecture well enough to protect supported behaviour, partner investment and SaaS readiness in the decisions owned by the role.
  
- Treat the internal platform as a product: use developer and operator research, feedback and adoption evidence to reduce cognitive load; provide self-service APIs and golden paths where they solve a demonstrated need.
  
- Use cloud-native service boundaries, versioned API contracts and event integration where appropriate, preserving compatibility and clear ownership across X3 capabilities.
  
- Apply CI/CD and secure software-supply-chain controls, with identity, secrets and policy enforcement built into relevant delivery and runtime paths.
  
- Make services diagnosable with OpenTelemetry-compatible logs, metrics and traces; define role-appropriate SLOs, reliability and resilience evidence.
  
- Manage performance and cost deliberately, and engineer lifecycle, upgrade, deprecation and rollback paths as part of supported capability ownership.
  
- Use migration, reconciliation and compatibility evidence to preserve customer data and behaviour while moving towards portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities.
  
- Use AI-assisted engineering securely, with human review, privacy and IP protection, regression evidence and a recovery path; use deterministic methods when they are more appropriate.
  
- Depth follows role scope: engineers demonstrate hands-on lifecycle capability in their discipline; managers, product and programme leaders, and architects need decision-relevant fluency, not universal coding or every tool. Containerisation and Kubernetes are required for all engineering roles. Infrastructure as code, GitOps and a custom internal developer platform apply where the role owns those paths.

title: Infrastructure Engineer AVP
description:

Business Area: Customer Digital and Data

Area of Expertise: Technology

Contract: Permanent

We are looking for an experienced AVP Infrastructure Engineer who can build and maintain infrastructure platforms and products that support applications and data systems, using hardware, software, networks, and cloud computing platforms as required with the aim of ensuring that the infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and secure. Ensure the reliability, availability, and scalability of the systems, platforms, and technology through the application of software engineering techniques, automation, and best practices in incident response.

* Hands-on in infrastructure engineering activities, including IAC, automation, design governance and troubleshooting.
* Define and implement standards, patterns and development best practices.

* Strong understanding of software architecture, maintainability, and modern engineering practices.

------------------------------

* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills.

* Experience driving a culture of engineering excellence and continuous improvement.

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing capabilities.
* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
* Collaborative and inclusive leadership style.
* Customer-focused mindset with strong attention to quality.

**Key Technical Skills and Experience**
---------------------------------------

* Programming language python or Java
* Technical Skills Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins, Shell script, Datadog, docker, containers, GitLab, Snyk, Qualys, Jira, Confluence, Datadog, JUnit, Maven, Gradle, and NPM
* AWS cloud computing EC2, ECR, EKS, S3, Cloud Formation, networks
* Database design and SQL
* Operating System knowledge – Windows, Linux and awareness on AIX
* System design and architecture.
* Experience with OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, token exchange, policy systems, delegated administration, or identity data modelling
* Ability to use AI engineering tools to accelerate research, code understanding, prototyping, implementation, and documentation while applying sound engineering judgment
* Experience building production services, distributed systems, or shared platform capabilities
* Experience designing and implementing APIs, RESTful services, integration contracts, and data or domain models
* Experience turning requirements and ambiguous problems into designs, prototypes, and production-ready solutions
* Experience with authentication, authorization, and identity management
* Ability to communicate technical decisions clearly, collaborate across teams and time zones, and support other engineers through feedback and knowledge sharing
* Familiarity with MCP, agent skills, and other agent integration concepts
* Experience contributing to technical designs and proof of concept work
* Manage incidents, problems, and changes using ITIL-aligned processes and SLAs (e.g., ServiceNow/Jira).
* Plan and execute OS patching cycles; maintain compliance with security and audit requirements.
* Maintain comprehensive runbooks, knowledge base articles, and support documentation.
* Very good understanding and solid hands-on on cloud computing system preferably AWS.
* Strong understanding on containers and hands-on experience in EKS/Docker also ability to write and deploy Helm chart.
* Build, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, Nexus) to improve release velocity and quality.
* Hands-on experience in Blue-Green deployments and good understanding of various other deployment strategy.

**Purpose of the role**

To build and maintain infrastructure platforms and products that support applications and data systems, using hardware, software, networks, and cloud computing platforms as required with the aim of ensuring that the infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and secure. Ensure the reliability, availability, and scalability of the systems, platforms, and technology through the application of software engineering techniques, automation, and best practices in incident response.

**Accountabilities**

* Build Engineering: Development, delivery, and maintenance of high-quality infrastructure solutions to fulfil business requirements ensuring measurable reliability, performance, availability, and ease of use. Including the identification of the appropriate technologies and solutions to meet business, optimisation, and resourcing requirements.
* Incident Management: Monitoring of IT infrastructure and system performance to measure, identify, address, and resolve any potential issues, vulnerabilities, or outages. Use of data to drive down mean time to resolution.

* Security: Implementation of a secure configuration and measures to protect infrastructure against cyber-attacks, vulnerabilities, and other security threats, including protection of hardware, software, and data from unauthorised access.
* Teamwork: Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, architects, and other engineers to define IT Infrastructure requirements, devise solutions, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives via a data driven approach.
* Learning: Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations, and actively contribute to the organization's technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.

* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Consultant, Data Engineering

description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

**Introduction to the team:**
-----------------------------

  

We’re the Insurance team at Expedia Group. We build services and customer experiences that help travelers find and manage trip-protection options across brands such as Expedia , Vrbo, and Hotels.com .

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

title: Software Development Engineer 5
description:
**Sr. Staff Data Platform Engineer**
------------------------------------

### **Position Summary**

As a Sr. Staff Data Platform Engineer, you will be the primary architect and visionary for the core data infrastructure that powers the entire enterprise. This is a "platform-as-a-product" role; your mission is to build the internal foundation—creating the high-performance engines, abstraction layers, and self-service frameworks that enable hundreds of other engineers to move faster.

You will operate at the intersection of Systems Programming and Data Engineering, solving "hard-tech" problems like automated schema evolution, multi-engine compute optimization, and global data discovery. As a top-level technical individual contributor, you will bridge the gap between long-term business strategy and deep-kernel technical execution, ensuring WEX’s data platform remains a competitive advantage.

Is this role for you?

* YES, if: You are a Backend/Software Engineer who loves solving "Big Data" problems, building APIs for data discovery, and optimizing distributed systems.
* NO, if: Your primary expertise is writing SQL queries, building Tableau dashboards, or managing ETL workflows without deep experience in Java or Python system architecture.

### **Responsibilities**

* Architectural Sovereignty: Define the 3-5 year technical roadmap for the Data Lakehouse. You aren't just using tools; you are deciding how storage, compute, and metadata layers (e.g., Apache Polaris, Unity Catalog or Datahub Catalog) interact at an elemental level.
* Platform-as-a-Product: Build internal SDKs, CLI tools, and automated orchestration frameworks. Your goal is to abstract away cloud complexity via Control Planes and Custom Operators, allowing Data Engineers to focus on business logic rather than infrastructure boilerplate.
* Internal R&D: Prototype and benchmark emerging technologies (e.g., specialized Spark extensions) to keep the platform at the bleeding edge of performance and cost-efficiency.
* Global Governance & Security: Architect "compliance-by-design" systems. Automate data lineage, PII masking, and fine-grained access control across petabyte-scale environments without sacrificing developer velocity.
* Engineering Excellence & Influence: Set the gold standard for code quality and system design across the company. You will lead Cross-Functional Architecture Reviews and serve as the final escalation point for the most complex system outages or performance bottlenecks.
* Organizational Mentorship: Beyond individual mentoring, you will foster an "Engineering Community," influencing the hiring bar and professional development paths for the entire data engineering organization.

### **Qualifications & Experience**

* Experience: 15+ years in software engineering and distributed systems, with at least 4 years in a principal or staff-level capacity leading platform-scale initiatives.

**Core Technical Competencies (Software Engineering Focus):**

* Strong Software Foundations: Strong fundamentals on software engineering, system architecture, and scalable production applications (Algorithms, Data Structures, and System Design).
* Experience in the Java/J2EE ecosystem (Spring Boot, Microservices) and python. We are looking for a developer who writes clean, testable, and high-performance code, not just scripts.
* Data as a Product: Experience building the platforms / framework engines and APIs that power data movement, rather than just building the ETL/ELT pipelines themselves.

**Data Lakehouse Mastery:**

* Deep internal knowledge of Apache Iceberg, Hudi, or Delta Lake (metadata management, manifest files, and compaction strategies).
* Experience contributing to or deeply customizing open-source data projects (e.g., Spark, dbt).

**Cloud & Infrastructure:**

* Extensive experience with cloud architecture and services, including AWS (S3, EMR, Kubernetes, Lambda) and Azure.
* Deep understanding of CI/CD automation, modern development tools, Git Actions, Terraform and frameworks.

**AI-Driven Development & Productivity:**

* AI Native Development: Experience leveraging AI Code Gen platforms into software development lifecycle (SDLC) to automate code generation, reviews, generate unit tests, and perform root-cause analysis of system failures.
* LLM-Ops for Platform: Ability to architect the infrastructure required to support AI Agent development by enabling vector database integration.

**Leadership & Vision:**

* Proven track record of "leading by influence"—driving adoption of new technologies across multiple autonomous teams.
* Ability to communicate complex architectural trade-offs (e.g., "Latency vs. Consistency" or "Build vs. Buy") to C-suite executives and junior engineers alike.

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science (Distributed Systems focus) preferred, or equivalent deep industry experience.

title: Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Job Summary**
---------------

We are looking for a skilled and motivated **Full-Stack AI Engineer** with hands-on experience in Python-based application development, modern frontend frameworks, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Generative AI, and Agentic AI.

The ideal candidate should be capable of developing end-to-end AI-powered applications, building scalable backend services and intuitive user interfaces, integrating Large Language Models (LLMs), and implementing AI-driven workflows. The candidate should have a strong foundation in software engineering, problem-solving, and the ability to translate business requirements into reliable, production-ready solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Design, develop, and maintain end-to-end full-stack applications using Python backend frameworks and modern frontend technologies.
* Build RESTful APIs and backend services using frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
* Develop responsive and interactive user interfaces using React.js or other modern frontend frameworks.
* Design and integrate Machine Learning and Deep Learning models into real-world applications.
* Develop Generative AI solutions using LLMs, prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search.
* Design and implement AI agents and multi-agent workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or similar technologies.
* Integrate AI models and services through APIs, including cloud-based AI platforms.
* Work with relational and NoSQL databases, data processing pipelines, and external service integrations.
* Develop efficient, maintainable, secure, and scalable code following software engineering best practices.
* Perform debugging, testing, performance optimization, and deployment of applications.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and deliver AI-driven business solutions.
* Explore emerging AI technologies and contribute to technical innovation and continuous improvement.

**Required Technical Skills**
-----------------------------

### **1. Full-Stack Development**

* Strong programming skills in Python.
* Hands-on experience with at least one Python backend framework: FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
* Experience building REST APIs, integrating third-party services, and implementing backend business logic.
* Working knowledge of React.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3, or an equivalent modern frontend framework.
* Understanding of frontend-backend integration, authentication, application architecture, and state management.

### **2. Machine Learning and Deep Learning**

* Understanding of core Machine Learning concepts, including supervised and unsupervised learning, classification, regression, clustering, and model evaluation.
* Familiarity with Deep Learning concepts and neural network architectures.
* Hands-on experience with libraries such as Scikit-learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow.
* Knowledge of data preprocessing, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, and inference.

### **3. Generative AI and LLM Applications**

* Hands-on experience building applications using LLMs from providers such as OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, or other equivalent platforms.
* Understanding of prompt engineering, structured outputs, function/tool calling, and context management.
* Experience implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines.
* Familiarity with embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, and document processing.
* Understanding of LLM evaluation, hallucination mitigation, and response quality optimization.

### **4. Agentic AI and AI Workflows**

* Understanding of AI agents, tool calling, workflow orchestration, and state management.
* Familiarity with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or equivalent technologies.
* Knowledge of multi-agent systems, planning, task decomposition, and tool integration.
* Ability to build AI workflows that interact with APIs, databases, and external systems.
* Understanding of agent evaluation, error handling, observability, and reliable execution.

### **5. Databases, Cloud, and Deployment**

* Working knowledge of SQL databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL.
* Familiarity with NoSQL databases and vector databases.
* Understanding of Git, version control, debugging, and testing.
* Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD, and application deployment.
* Exposure to cloud platform (Microsoft Azure).
* Understanding of application security, logging, monitoring, and performance optimization.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2+ years of relevant software engineering or AI application development experience.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently, learn new technologies quickly, and collaborate effectively with a team.
* Strong communication skills and a willingness to take ownership of assigned tasks.

We (C5i) do not charge/accept any amount or security deposit from job seekers during the selection process or while inviting candidates for an interview.

title: Principal Formal Design Verification Engineer
description:
**Overview**

Microsoft Silicon, Cloud Hardware, and Infrastructure Engineering (*SCHIE*) is the team behind Microsoft’s expanding Cloud Infrastructure and responsible for powering Microsoft’s “Intelligent Cloud” mission. SCHIE delivers the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's over 200 online businesses including Bing, MSN, Office 365, Xbox Live, Teams, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform globally with our server and data center infrastructure, security and compliance, operations, globalization, and manageability solutions. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering a trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide and we are looking for engineers to help achieve that mission.

The Compute Silicon & Manufacturing Engineering (CSME) organization within SCHIE is responsible for design, development, manufacturing and packaging of Microsoft's state-of-the-art computer chips, notably the Azure Cobalt. Our solutions provide sustainable strategic advantages to Microsoft and enable our customers to achieve more.

As Microsoft's cloud business continues to grow the ability to deploy new offerings and hardware infrastructure on time, in high volume with high quality and lowest cost is of paramount importance. To achieve this goal, the **Verification & Validation** team is instrumental in defining and delivering operational measures of success for hardware manufacturing, improving the planning process, quality, delivery, scale and sustainability related to Microsoft cloud hardware. We are looking for experienced engineers with a dedicated passion for customer focused solutions, insight and industry knowledge to envision and implement future technical solutions that will manage and optimize the Cloud infrastructure.

We are looking for a **Principal** **Formal Design Verification Engineer** to join the team to support our mission and culture. This key role will impact the organization by **driving formal verification strategy and execution for complex IP/SOC designs.**

#SCHIE #CSME

  
  
**Responsibilities**

The candidate for this position will be expected and able to complete the following responsibilities:

* Own or lead Formal verification of Fabric Interconnect architectures, IPs, subsystems, and reusable Fabric components from planning through signoff.
* Partner with architecture, design, and verification teams to define Formal verification strategies, methodologies, test plans, and signoff criteria.
* Develop and enhance Formal verification environments, assertions, abstraction models, checkers, and reusable verification collateral, while driving convergence an execution to closure
* Drive root-cause analysis and closure of complex design and verification issues through Formal analysis, simulation, and debug.
* Improve verification productivity through automation, methodologies, and AI-assisted solutions.
* Coach and mentor engineers in Formal verification methodologies, debug techniques and best practices.
* Demonstrate Microsoft core values: Customer Focus, Adaptability, Collaboration, Growth Mindset, Drive for Results, Influence for Impact, Judgement, and Diversity & Inclusion.

  
**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications:**

* 12+ years of relevant technical engineering experience
* Candidate must have at least a bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical, Electronics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a related degree
* 5+ years of hands-on pre-silicon Formal verification experience at the IP, subsystem, or SoC level.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated expertise applying Formal verification methodologies to complex IPs, subsystems, SoCs, or reusable library components.
* Deep technical expertise in one or more of the following: Fabric Interconnects, coherency, CHI, AMBA, PCIe, CXL, protocol bridges, virtualization, security, or memory subsystems.
* Experience driving verification from planning through signoff across multiple product cycles.
* Experience developing scalable Formal verification environments, assertions, assumptions, checkers, and reusable verification collateral.
* Experience solving complex cross-team technical challenges and driving verification closure.
* Working knowledge of simulation-based verification methodologies, including System Verilog, UVM, assertions, and coverage-driven verification.
* Proficiency with Python or similar scripting languages for automation and verification productivity.
* Experience applying AI-assisted tools to engineering and verification workflows

**Screening Requirements**

* Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.
* This role will require access to information that is controlled for export under export control regulations, potentially under the U.S. International Traffic in Arms Regulations or Export Administration Regulations, the EU Dual Use Regulation, and/or other export control regulations. As a condition of employment, the successful candidate will be required to provide either proof of their country of citizenship or proof of their US. residency or other protected status (e.g., under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)) for assessment of eligibility to access the export-controlled information. To meet this legal requirement, and as a condition of employment, the successful candidate’s citizenship will be verified with a valid passport. Lawful permanent residents, refugees, and asylees may verify status using other documents, where applicable.

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process**.**

description:
**Job Requirements**  

We are looking for an experienced Test Manager with Test Architecture responsibilities. The role combines approximately Test Management and overall project test ownership with technical leadership.

The role is the single point of accountability for planning, coordinating, driving, monitoring, evaluating, and reporting all testing required for the project across the complete product lifecycle. This includes testing performed by internal teams, development teams, distributed teams, suppliers, and external validation partners.

The role will establish and govern an effective overall test approach, including appropriate use of test architecture, testability, automation, infrastructure, tools, continuous integration, and LLM/GenAI-enabled testing practices. Plan, coordinate, drive, and control all required testing across the product lifecycle, including software, integration, system, regression, and applicable functional and non-functional testing.

Plan and control test phases, resources, schedules, dependencies, environments,infrastructure, and regression activities.

Coordinate testing performed by internal teams, development teams, distributed teams, suppliers, and external validation partners.

Continuously improve test planning, governance, methods, metrics, and lifecycle integration.

requirements, tools, and testing methods in alignment with project and quality goals.

title: Principal Business Solution Analyst, AI Delivery Hub
description:
**Job Title**

Principal Business Solution Analyst, AI Delivery Hub

**About the Role**
------------------

As a Functional Lead Analyst within the AI Delivery Hub, you will serve as a key link between Product Managers and engineering teams, helping translate visionary concepts into functional, scalable, and user-focused solutions.

You will work at the intersection of travel technology and artificial intelligence, supporting the creation of innovative tools that connect Amadeus travel capabilities—such as flight booking, hotel content, check-in, and travel-document verification—to leading AI platforms.

In this position, you’ll collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders, clarify business needs, document requirements, and shape solutions ready for production in a dynamic, exploratory environment.

  

**In this role, you’ll:**
-------------------------

* Collaborate with Product Managers, engineers, architects, QA teams, and AI-assistant partners to transform product vision into actionable and scalable requirements.
* Analyze business and functional needs, and translate them into clear, well-documented user stories and technical recommendations.
* Facilitate functional workshops, ensuring understanding across finance, legal, security, and operations teams.
* Partner with engineers during the design and build phases, providing guidance and ensuring clarity of functionality and requirements.
* Document and communicate progress, sharing updates and validated solutions at key milestones.
* Conduct cross-functional analysis across internal systems and external providers to support design and integration.
* Contribute to architecture planning, offering functional insights for new product concepts.
* Simplify complex technical topics, presenting them accessibly to diverse audiences, including cross-functional teams and AI-partner stakeholders.
* Support testing and validation activities, ensuring traceability and system integrity across product experiences.
Mentor colleagues and foster collaboration, helping new members integrate and succeed.  

  

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Clear and consistent translation of product vision into actionable requirements.
* Strong collaboration and mutual trust between product, engineering, and partner teams.
* Teams deliver reliable, high-quality solutions efficiently.
* Documentation remains current, complete, and accessible.
* Knowledge sharing and mentorship are a core part of team culture.

**Your Profile**
----------------

* Experience bridging business and technology, preferably across complex or cross-functional projects.
* Ability to perform functional and technical analysis, simplifying complexity into clarity.
* Strong skills in communication, coordination, and documentation across diverse audiences.
* Comfortable working in dynamic, innovative, and evolving environments.
Demonstrated ability to mentor, coach, and promote collaborative problem-solving across teams.  

  

**What we can offer you**
-------------------------

A truly global DNA - Everything at Amadeus is global, from our people to our business, which translates into our footprint, processes, and culture.
  
Great opportunities to learn - Learning happens all the time and in many ways at Amadeus, through on-the-job training, formal learning activities, and day-to-day interactions with colleagues.
  
A caring environment - Amadeus fosters a caring environment, nurturing both a fulfilling career and personal and family life. We care about our employees and strive to provide a supportive work environment.
  
A hybrid working model - We want our employees to do their best work, however the hybrid model works best for them.
  
A diverse and inclusive community - We are committed to leveraging our uniquely diverse population to drive innovation, creativity, and collaboration across our organization.
  
A Reliable Company - Trust and reliability are fundamental values that drive our actions and shape long-lasting relationships with our customers, partners, and employees.
  
A critical mission and purpose - At Amadeus, you will be powering the future of travel and pursuing a critical mission and extraordinary purpose.

title: Staff Digital Verification Engineer
description:
**Company Description**

Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. **Job Description:**

Renesas is seeking a Staff Digital Design Verification Engineer to join our team developing complex power management SoCs. These products integrate digital control, telemetry, fault management, communication interfaces, configurable peripherals, and advanced power-control functions for AI, datacenter, enterprise computing, networking, and high-performance power delivery applications.

You will independently own verification of significant blocks and features from planning through closure. The role combines hands-on UVM development, coverage-driven verification, complex debug, and close collaboration with architecture, RTL design, firmware, analog, validation, and systems teams.

**Responsibilities:**

* Own verification of complex digital blocks or major SoC features from requirements analysis through coverage closure.
* Develop feature-based verification plans from product, architecture, and microarchitecture specifications; identify gaps, ambiguities, corner cases, and risks.
* Build and extend reusable SystemVerilog/UVM environments, including sequences, monitors, scoreboards, checkers, assertions, and coverage models.
* Develop constrained random and targeted tests for normal operation, error handling, recovery, and system-level interactions.
* Drive functional, code, toggle, FSM, and assertion coverage closure using regression and coverage data.
* Debug RTL, testbench, assertion, integration, and regression failures; collaborate with design and firmware teams to isolate issues and verify fixes.
* Automate regression, triage, reporting, and analysis workflows using scripting and modern engineering tools.
Communicate status, risks, dependencies, and closure evidence clearly; provide technical guidance to less-experienced engineers.  

  
  
**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's or master's degree in electrical engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
* 7 or more years of relevant digital design verification experience, or equivalent directly applicable experience.
* Demonstrated ownership of a complex block, subsystem, or major feature from verification planning through closure.
* Strong proficiency in SystemVerilog, UVM, constrained random verification, functional coverage, and SystemVerilog Assertions.
* Experience translating specifications into test plans, test scenarios, checkers, scoreboards, assertions, coverage models, and closure criteria.
* Hands-on experience developing and debugging reusable UVM environments and analyzing complex regression failures.
* Strong RTL and testbench debug skills, with the ability to distinguish design, environment, test, firmware, and specification issues.
* Working knowledge of digital design fundamentals, including state machines, clocks and resets, interrupts, register interfaces, memories, and clock-domain crossings.
* Proficiency in Linux and at least one scripting language such as Python, Bash, Perl, or Tcl.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively across architecture, design, firmware, analog, validation, and systems teams.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience verifying complex SoCs, power management ICs, voltage regulators, digital controllers, or mixed-signal products.
* Experience verifying RTL interfaces to embedded processors, memory-mapped peripherals, and firmware-controlled hardware features.
* Familiarity with PMBus, AVSBus, SVID or SVI3, I2C, SPI, or similar control and communication protocols.
* Understanding of telemetry, fault and alert handling, power sequencing, multiphase regulation, or digital control loops.
* Experience with Cadence Xcelium, SimVision, vManager, JasperGold, Synopsys VCS, Verdi, or comparable tools.
* Experience with formal verification, gate-level simulation, silicon bring-up, or pre-silicon-to-silicon correlation.
Experience improving regression infrastructure, coverage analytics, failure triage, or verification automation.  

What You Bring

* Strong technical ownership and a disciplined approach to verification completeness.
* Ability to reason beyond directed requirements and identify meaningful corner cases and feature interactions.
* Clear communication of technical risk, progress, and signoff evidence.
A collaborative mindset and interest in improving verification methodology and productivity.

**Business Justification as to why this hire is required, is this a backfill or additional headcount:**

  

Additional senior engineering capacity is required to execute the architectural transition of the Synergy Bluetooth host stack from APSS to the Q6 low-power domain. The role will strengthen full-stack Bluetooth ownership, accelerate architecture and product problem solving, and enable scalable development across XR and Wearables programs.

**Job Overview - Dept Description and Job Duties:**

  

The Bluetooth Common IP team is seeking a highly analytical and hands-on Senior Engineer to design, develop, port, integrate, and sustain Bluetooth host software across APSS and Q6/LPI environments. The engineer will be a key contributor to the full-stack architecture in which Bluetooth host protocols, profiles, application services, and supporting platform interfaces progressively evolve to meet Days of Use (DOU) targets for our products in XR & Wearables.

  

This is an implementation-focused role for an exceptional developer who can work from Bluetooth specification and system architecture through detailed design, efficient C code, integration, debugging, and productization. The engineer is expected to use AI-assisted engineering responsibly to accelerate understanding, development, reviews, test creation, failure analysis, and documentation while independently validating all outputs.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Bluetooth stack development: Develop and maintain Bluetooth Classic, Bluetooth Low Energy, and LE Audio host protocols, profiles, services, and product-specific use cases.

* Platform adaptation: Port or redesign OS, memory, threading, timer, storage, security, IPC, transport, logging, and diagnostic dependencies for a resource-constrained low-power execution environment.

* Architecture and interfaces: Define clean, scalable module boundaries and APIs between the Bluetooth stack, controller transport, audio services, offload framework, OEM applications, Android/APSS services, and Q6 platform components.

* End-to-end ownership: Own features from requirements and feasibility through design, implementation, unit testing, integration, interoperability, performance optimization, issue resolution, and release support.

* Protocol analysis: Translate Bluetooth Core and profile specifications into robust implementations and use protocol-level reasoning to diagnose failures across host, controller, transport, peer device, and application layers.

* Performance and robustness: Optimize memory footprint, compute utilization, latency, concurrency, power behavior, and recovery paths for embedded and low-power targets.

* AI-assisted engineering: Use approved AI coding and analysis tools to accelerate code comprehension, solution exploration, test generation, log triage, documentation, and repetitive development tasks. Apply engineering judgment, security discipline, source review, and thorough validation before adoption.

* Collaboration and technical leadership: Partner with Bluetooth firmware, audio, systems, platform, application, test, product, and customer engineering teams. Drive design reviews, mentor engineers, identify risks early, and communicate decisions and trade-offs clearly.

  

Qualifications needed

* Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.

* 6+ years of embedded software development experience, with strong hands-on development in C/C++ for wireless connectivity or comparable embedded products.

* Strong working knowledge of Bluetooth architecture, host-controller interactions, and Bluetooth Classic/BLE protocols, with the ability to scale rapidly into unfamiliar protocols, profiles, specifications, and product use cases.

* Excellent C programming, data-structure, concurrency, memory-management, and defensive-programming skills.

* Strong analytical problem-solving ability, including decomposition of ambiguous system issues, hypothesis-driven debugging, trade-off evaluation, and root-cause isolation across software and hardware boundaries.

* Experience with IPC, multithreading, synchronization, transport interfaces, embedded storage, logging, and debugging of distributed or multi-processor systems.

* Ability to read specifications, architecture documents, code, traces, and logs and convert them into clear designs and reliable implementations.

* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including design documentation, technical presentations, and cross-functional reviews.

Minimum Qualifications:

* At least 3-6 years’ experience in embedded SW development using the C programming language for Wireless connectivity products

* Demonstrated ability to design, port, debug, and optimize complex software on Linux and/or RTOS environments.

* Experience porting a protocol stack to MCU, or RTOS-based low-power execution environments.

* Practical experience using enterprise-approved generative AI or coding assistants, with a strong understanding of validation, confidentiality, licensing, and secure-development expectations.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience with Bluetooth sniffers, air traces, HCI snoop logs, protocol analyzers, embedded debuggers, crash dumps, and performance/power profiling.

title: Senior AI Evals Engineer
description:
**About the Role**
------------------

The **Senior AI Evals Test Engineer** is a hands-on technical role responsible for defining, developing, and executing robust evaluation frameworks and test strategies for AI agents built using the **Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) or similar sort of agentic frameworks**. This role bridges AI development and reliable deployment — ensuring our agents are safe, ethical, effective, and meet high-quality performance standards. A significant focus of the role is on Responsible AI and Safety Evals, including **adversarial testing, red-teaming, bias detection, and toxicity measurement**. The engineer will **design scalable evaluation pipelines**, build synthetic test environments, and work closely with AI/ML Engineers, Researchers, and policy teams to ensure agents are production-ready and compliant with regulatory and ethical standards. The role is **70% Automation and 30% Manual Testing**, and sits within the **Applied AI: Test Engineering team** as a key technical authority.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Design and build agent evaluation frameworks** — create end-to-end infrastructure for evaluating LLM-based agents across correctness, latency, cost, safety, and task completion rate
* **Build synthetic testing environments and simulation strategies** to stress-test AI agents under diverse real-world conditions, with specific focus on agents built on Google ADK and related Google AI/ML services (e.g., Vertex AI, Gemini models)
* **Build golden datasets and test harnesses** — curate domain-specific evaluation sets for Rubrik's product verticals (data security, SaaS protection, cyber recovery, compliance)
* **Establish eval-as-a-service** — build and enhance centralized evaluation platform that any IT team members can self-serve to test their agents against standardized and custom benchmarks
* **Automate regression and drift detection** — implement CI/CD-integrated eval pipelines that catch regressions on every model or prompt change before production deployment
* **Define eval taxonomies and rubrics** — establish structured scoring criteria for agentic workflows (tool use accuracy, multi-step reasoning, hallucination rate, policy adherence, error recovery)
* **Instrument production observability** — build real-time monitoring for agent quality in production: success rates, user corrections, fallback triggers, escalation patterns
* **Benchmark and select models** — run structured model comparisons (cost, quality, latency trade-offs) to inform model selection decisions across agent use cases
* **Analyze and interpret evaluation results**, providing clear, actionable quality and safety reports to stakeholders and development teams, with specific focus on risk metrics, trend analysis, and mitigation recommendations
* **Define comprehensive end-to-end QA strategies** — functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing (UAT) — tailored for conversational and goal-oriented AI agents with tool-use, memory, and multi-turn reasoning capabilities
* **Develop and maintain detailed test artifacts** (test plans, test cases, test scenarios, automated test suites) covering agent features, tool invocation, memory persistence, and reasoning accuracy across evolving model versions
* **Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects**, performance regressions, and alignment failures using Jira, collaborating closely with Applied AI Engineers to analyze root causes and validate fixes
* **Evaluate new technologies and patterns** (e.g., new tools for Agent Evals), run proofs-of-concept, and influence the platform roadmap
* **Partner with policy and legal teams** to ensure agent evaluations systematically cover regulatory compliance, fairness objectives, and emerging AI governance requirements
* **Provide technical leadership to engineers**, including solutioning, design reviews, code reviews, pair programming, and mentoring of junior and contract engineers
* **Collaborate cross-functionally** — work closely with ML engineers, product teams, platform engineers, and security to embed eval-driven quality gates into the agent development lifecycle

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

### **Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* **8+ years of overall software Test engineering experience**, with 5+ years focused on test engineering, QA automation, or developer tooling, and demonstrated ability to build evaluation systems across multiple AI/ML domains, conversational agents, or Large Language Models (LLMs)
* **2+ years working with ML/AI systems, building**, testing, or evaluating models in production environments, including hands-on experience with LLM-based applications, prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, or agentic workflows
* **2+ years as a senior/lead, owning evaluation strategy,** quality frameworks, and technical decisions for complex AI agent systems in an enterprise product environment
* **1+ years** in designing or operating evaluation frameworks specifically for generative AI / LLM agents, including benchmarking, red-teaming, and production quality monitoring in the AI ADLC model

### **Technical Skills**

* **Deep hands-on experience with LLM evaluation** — familiarity with frameworks and libraries such as LangSmith, DeepEval,LLM as a Judge, Promptfoo, RAGAS, Hugging Face evaluation tooling, custom eval harnesses
* **Strong understanding of agentic AI patterns** — tool use, function calling, multi-step planning, ReAct/CoT reasoning chains, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
* **Production experience with eval pipelines** — building automated, CI-integrated evaluation infrastructure (not just notebooks)
* **Proficiency in Python** — strong scripting and tooling skills; experience with pytest, async patterns, and data processing at scale
* **Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or any Cloud Service** relevant to AI/ML (e.g., Vertex AI) and experience integrating testing into MLOps workflows
* **Statistical literacy** — ability to design experiments, interpret eval metrics with appropriate confidence, and avoid common pitfalls (overfitting to benchmarks, metric gaming)
* **Enterprise product sensibility** — understanding of how AI quality translates to customer trust in a B2B/enterprise context (security, compliance, reliability SLAs)
* **Excellent communication** — ability to present eval results and quality trade-offs to engineering leadership, articulate risks and safety findings to non-technical audiences, and drive alignment on ship/no-ship decisions
* **Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and Git-based workflows**, including automated testing, static analysis, deployment automation, and environment configuration for our DevTestOps

### **Tech Stack:**

* **Languages:** Python(Must), TypeScript, Java (Optional)
* **Test Automation:Selenium, Playwright**
* **LLM Providers:** Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, open-source models
* **Eval Tooling:** DeepEvals(Must), LLM as a Judge (Must), Promptfoo/RAGAS/LangSmith/ Custom harnesses
* **Agent Evals Frameworks/libraries:** LangGraph, Claude Agent SDK, custom orchestrators
* **Infrastructure:**DevOps (Basic), Kubernetes, CI/CD (Jenkins/GitHub Actions), observability stacks (Datadog/Grafana)

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* **Deep Learning/NLP Knowledge**: Fundamental understanding of how LLMs work, including concepts like RAG, prompting, and the technical challenges related to alignment
* **Data Analysis:** Experience with data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., Pandas, SQL) for analyzing evaluation and safety results
* **Policy Background:** Familiarity with AI ethics principles and industry standards for responsible AI development
* **Garbage-in/Garbage-out (GIGO) Tools**: Any tool or framework that specializes in testing the model's response to highly ambiguous, misleading, or malformed inputs to test for robustness and safety failures
* **Experience testing complex APIs,** especially for tool-integration and function-calling scenarios in agentic workflows
* **Experience with prompt injection (Must)** and data poisoning skills is a plus
* **Certifications in AI/ML**, cloud platforms (GCP, AWS), AWS Machine Learning Specialty, Google Professional ML Engineer, DeepLearning.AI specializations and software testing methodologies

**Soft Skills**
---------------

* **Proven ability to lead without direct authority**, influencing cross-functional teams and driving technical decisions through clarity and data rather than hierarchy.
* **Experience working in agile environments**, collaborating closely with product owners, scrum teams, and distributed stakeholders across time zones.
* **Excellent communication and documentation skills**, comfortable presenting solutions and trade-offs to engineers, managers, and senior business stakeholders.
* **Strong architectural thinking and problem-solving skills**, including the ability to decompose complex business processes into simple solutions

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience evaluating agents in cybersecurity, data protection, or infrastructure domains
* Familiarity with Rubrik's product portfolio or similar enterprise data management platforms
* Hands-on with human-in-the-loop eval workflows (annotation platforms, inter-rater reliability)
* Experience with model fine-tuning evaluation (pre/post quality comparison)
* Background in building internal developer platforms or tooling teams
* Contributions to open-source eval frameworks or published work on AI evaluation methodology
* Drive red-teaming and adversarial testing — design adversarial evaluation suites for jailbreak resistance, data leakage prevention, and boundary enforcement in enterprise-grade agents

**Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation**
----------------------------------------------------------------------

Rubrik (RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, leads at the intersection of data protection, cyber resilience, and enterprise AI acceleration. Rubrik Security Cloud delivers complete cyber resilience by securing, monitoring, and recovering data, identities, and workloads across clouds. Rubrik Agent Cloud accelerates trusted AI agent deployments at scale by monitoring and auditing agentic actions, enforcing real-time guardrails, fine-tuning for accuracy and undoing agentic mistakes.

  

**Inclusion @ Rubrik**

At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. Our commitment to inclusion is at the heart of our mission to secure the world’s data.

description:

And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

title: Technical Consulting Engineer
description:
Job Description
  
  
Who We Are
  
**The name ThousandEyes was born from two big ideas:** the power to see things not ordinarily possible and the ability to collect insights from a multitude of vantage points. As the world continues its digital transformation and relies more on cloud services and the Internet, the"network" which is now both public and private, has become a black box our customers cannot see or understand.
  
  
Our Internet and cloud intelligence platform delivers the only collectively powered real-time view of the Internet and private networks, cloud, and SaaS platforms, helping enterprises and service providers identify problems before they impact revenue, damage brand reputation, or halt employee productivity.
  
  
In August 2020, Cisco Systems completed the acquisition of ThousandEyes, which now forms the ThousandEyes Business Unit within the Cisco Networking Business Group and is the Network Assurance solution for Cisco across the Cisco Networking Cloud and Cisco Security Cloud. ThousandEyes is also a foundational component of Cisco’s growing Full-Stack Observability "FS") business.
  
  
About The Role
  
We're all familiar with the technology, but have you ever wondered how the Internet actually works? At ThousandEyes, we spend every day working to help customers understand the gotchas of Internet-based service delivery: how to identify problems, how to resolve, and how to avoid them in the future. Our Customer Engineering team is tasked with empowering our customers with ThousandEyes to ease their performance monitoring pains.
  
  
If you enjoy variety in job responsibilities, this is the job for you. A day may involve helping a customer identify network loss in an undersea cable, diagnose the cause of a route leak impacting significant portions of internet traffic, scripting an approach to monitoring a website's login flow, spinning up a lab environment to reproduce a strange set of behaviors seen in a customer's environment, saving a company hours of bridge time during a significant outage impacting their infrastructure by finding the smoking-gun in a network outage, or simply helping someone understand the way that our applications work. The job is highly variable and requires both the ability to make data-driven decisions, and draw conclusions based on incomplete information. We're looking for out-of-the-box thinkers who can complement and extend the already formidable talents of our Customer Engineering organization.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  

* Provide advanced technical expertise and leadership in solving complex, high-impact customer issues
* Lead the creation, refinement, and delivery of technical documentation, training materials, and knowledge content
* Partner closely with Engineering and Product teams to address systemic product issues and influence roadmap decisions

* Promote ThousandEyes' culture of collaboration, innovation, and technical excellence
* Timely interaction with customers and internal teams requesting support via online-chat, email and phone
* Active participation in 24x7 Support Coverage model

Qualifications
  

* A standout"customer firs" attitude
