* 4-7 + years of experience in a technical support, engineering, or related customer-facing role
* Specialist-level certifications (e.g. CCNP) or equivalent advance technical credentials preferred
* Experience with Cloud/SaaS software products is highly desirable
* Familiar with core networking principles - TCP/IP, DNS, web technologies, proxies and VoIP
* Working knowledge of virtualization technology - containers, virtualBox, VMware, HyperV, Xen
* Working knowledge in security - authentication, permissions, SSO
* Knowledge of one computer languages and programming (Java, Python, XML, RESTAPI) frameworks desirable
* Experience with the administration of Linux based Operations Systems a plus
* Experience in technical writing is a plus
* Ability to prioritize& complete tasks in a timely fashion
* Ability to communicate clearly and concisely to technical and non-technical users
* Proven troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
* Expert in one or more technical domains; broad knowledge across ThousandEyes and networking technologies
* Proficient in automation, programmability, orchestration, virtualization, and/or security
* Reads and applies industry standards, RFCs, and architectural documents
* Mentors team members and drives team goals into actionable initiatives
* Influences product development through trends analysis and cross-functional collaboration
* Regional or global impact; regularly interacts with customers, leadership, and product teams
* Leads original and creative initiatives that are critical to organization success

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
Disclaimer

title: Staff Compiler Performance Engineer
description:
**Falcon** is the optimizing just in time (JIT) compiler in Azul Platform Prime. It compiles hot Java bytecode into highly optimized machine code and delivers Java performance that standard JVMs do not reach. Falcon is built on LLVM.

We are looking for a **Staff Compiler Performance Engineer** to set the technical direction for Falcon performance. This is not a compiler front end role and not a compiler built from scratch: Falcon is mature and runs in production at large enterprises. You will decide where the next significant performance gains come from, lead the design of the optimizations that deliver them, and make sure the compiler architecture supports the product roadmap.

You will be the senior technical voice on a distributed team of compiler experts and a key partner for runtime, GC and product teams.

### **What You Will Do (aka Responsibilities)**

* Define the performance strategy for Falcon: identify the largest opportunities across benchmarks and customer workloads and turn them into a technical roadmap
* Lead design of complex, cross cutting optimizations in the optimizer and code generator, and of the interfaces between the compiler, the runtime and the garbage collector
* Make architectural decisions on the Falcon optimization pipeline, compile time budget and tiering strategy
* Lead enablement of Falcon on new hardware platforms and new Azul products
* Mentor senior engineers, review critical designs and code, and set standards for performance methodology and validation
* Represent Azul in the LLVM community: drive upstream design discussions and contributions that benefit managed language compilers

### **What You'll Bring (aka Experience, Skills)**

* 8+ years of professional experience developing optimizing compilers or JIT compilers
* Track record of technical leadership: owning the design of major compiler components or optimization frameworks used in production
* Expert C++ skills and experience in large, long lived codebases
* Deep expertise in compiler optimization and code generation, with a clear view of the tradeoffs between peak performance, compile time, warmup and code size
* Expert performance analysis skills down to the microarchitecture level

### **Nice to Have**

* Recognized contributions to LLVM or another major compiler: code owner, maintainer or author of significant upstream work
* Deep experience with JIT compilers for managed languages: HotSpot C2, Graal, V8, .NET RyuJIT or similar
* Experience working closely with runtime and GC teams on speculation, deoptimization and barrier design

title: Lead Data & AI Engineer
Strategic Builder
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

**The Experience**

Customer impact from day one. Strategic clarity and Execution that sticks.

  

Salesforce is hiring Deployment Strategists — Strategic Builders who are customer-facing advisors, who define AI strategy, shape agentic solutions, and drive measurable adoption for enterprise customers. You'll work as part of a delivery team alongside Forward Deployed Engineers, translating complex business challenges into agentic AI deployments that go live and generate real value.

  

Engagements are focused and time-bound — typically 12 weeks or less — and may span a single strategic account or multiple customers simultaneously. Your impact isn't just getting to deployment. It ensures customers realise lasting, scalable value from the solutions your team builds.

  

**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

  
Full Lifecycle Ownership: Lead end-to-end customer engagement across the complete value lifecycle — Identify Commit Deploy

* Consume — owning outcomes at every stage, not just discovery or deal closure
* AI Strategy & Architecture: Define the customer's Agentic AI strategy and roadmap. Lead design workshops, agent design sessions, and jobs-to-be-done analysis. Architect solutions spanning Salesforce's agentic AI platform, Data Cloud, and enterprise systems, with responsible AI governance baked in from the start.
* Deployment Oversight & Program Management: Manage engagement delivery end-to-end timelines, stakeholder communication, risk escalation, and progress reporting. You are the operational backbone of your delivery team, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.
* Adoption & Consumption: Own adoption, consumption, and expansion metrics within your engagement scope. Identify blockers early and develop strategies to drive measurable value realization
* Delivery Team Coordination: Partner closely with the Forward Deployed Engineers on your team to align strategy with technical execution. Keep the team focused, unblocked, and on track to hit delivery milestones.
* AI-Supported Development: You'll be developing real customer solutions supported by leading-edge AI tools: Including
* Cursor, Claude, and our coding products like Vibes, to accelerate development.
* Customer Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary customer-facing contact, building trust-based relationships with senior stakeholders and present proposals, decisions and outcomes in terms of business value, not just technical detail.
* AI Readiness: Assess customer readiness for AI adoption and guide change management and process transformation to maximise the benefits of intelligent agents
Product Feedback Loop: Synthesise field insights and translate them into actionable product feedback that influences Salesforce's Agentic AI platform roadmap.  

  

**You're Our Person If...**

  

* 4+ years experience in strategic solutioning, technical advisory, or delivery leadership or programme management for enterprise cloud or SaaS technology
* You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field
* Prior customer-facing delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or technical advisory) - this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have
* Demonstrated understanding of the Salesforce platform and ecosystem, including Agentic AI capabilities and Data Cloud
* Working knowledge of one or more programming languages: Python, JavaScript, Java, or Apex
* Proven ability to lead and own complex, ambiguous engagements end-to-end — from discovery through to measurable outcomes
* Experience leading AI/LLM solution design, including agentic AI strategy, conversation design, and responsible AI practices
* Strong project and programme management skills — ability to run multiple workstreams, manage stakeholder expectations, and keep delivery on track in ambiguous environments
Ability to travel 25% of the time to customer sites  

  

**Even Better If...**

  

* Experience with Salesforce Data Cloud, Agentforce platform, and Salesforce CRM (Sales, Service, Marketing)
* Experience designing and deploying AI solutions in regulated industries (e.g., public sector, financial services, healthcare)
* Salesforce platform certifications (e.g., Data Cloud Consultant, Agentforce Specialist, Application Architect) or similar platform certifications such as Microsoft, Oracle, or similar platforms.
* Background in change management, organisational design, or enterprise transformation
* Experience with AI/ML concepts beyond LLMs, including NLP, RAG architectures, and model evaluation frameworks
* A get-things-done mindset with strong bias for action — comfortable operating in unstructured fast moving environments

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. title: Mechanical Engineering Technical Leader
description:
**Meet the Team:** -
  
The mechanical& thermal team is an integrated part of HW organization, responsible for varieties of complex electro-mechanical designs, which includes but are not limited to central office networking products (product ranges from 1RU to 40RU sizes), outdoor mobility equipment, high performance thermal solutions and complex PCB assemblies.
  
  
**Your Impact:**  

* May lead small scale mechanical engineering projects (one to two features) with manageable risks and resource requirements and may take on project management responsibilities
* Collaborates with multiple stakeholders to support assembly, fabrication and manufacturing of products by using an understanding of manufacturing process for plastic, diecast, sheet metal, interconnect and power delivery and conducts failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA)
* Performs stack up tolerance analyses to ensure designs meet six sigma quality for high volume mass production
* Assists senior engineers with test plans, mechanical design testing, failure analysis, reliability, environmental testing and verification plans for developed design elements, materials, parts and products.
* Verifies the quality of the design, resolves issues and advances as needed
* Performs moderately complex simulation with supervision from senior engineers
* Reviews and compiles the BoM for large teams or across multiple products
* Contributes to design improvements and assembly cost savings and avoidance by helping identify the right materials
* Monitors scope, schedule and budgets for projects
* Collaborates with multiple stakeholders to conduct design feasibility testing and prototyping, including working with marketing teams directly to ensure feature and requests from customers are achievable
* Ensures that feasibility and prototyping guidelines are met
* Performs simple mechanical simulations such as FEA analysis to support design features
* Optimizes thermal solutions with thermal engineers prior to prototype

**Minimum Qualifications:**  
Bachelors + 10-14 years of related experience, or Masters + 8-10 years of related experience, or PhD + 6-8 years of related experience
  
  

* Hands on thermal design and validation experience in electro-mechanical equipment that would be deployed in different environments ranging from central office (controlled environment) to outdoor (uncontrolled environment).
* Expertise in concept/architecture, establishing thermal boundaries and optimized cooling solutions which allow to maximise the performance of equipment with minimal power budget for cooling.
* Expertise in design and verification of latest heatsink technologies (Heat pipes, Chill/Cold plates, 2D/3D vapor chambers) which include air and liquid based medium for cooling.
* Strong validation background and ability to plan a comprehensive test plan with minimal iterations.
* Strong command on simulation tools and modelling of complex thermal environment.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Strong communication skills with c/f collaboration and problem-solving abilities.
* Good knowledge of Mechanical design and manufacturing processes.
* Experience in product design validation, particularly in thermal and mechanical areas, is required.
* Good knowledge of Fan/TIM/Heatsink types of selection and verification.
* Experience in generating automation tools, Python scripting for data management and smart design and review.
* Hands on Experience with Electronics cooling tools like Flotherm, Flotherm XT, Ansys Icepak, Ansys CFX
* Hands on experience in Liquid cooling technology, wrt both testing and design tools and manufacturing techniques.
* ASIC level knowledge on handling detailed thermal models containing core details like power maps, TIM1, TIM1.5, TIM2 Bond line thickness, Lidded/Lidless, Silicon 2D/2.5Detc.,
* Hands on Experience in using AI tools in day-to-day work.
* Hands on knowledge on using Thermal testing tools with available DAQ’s in the market, Environmental chambers.
* Proficient in creating test plans, executing tests, and reporting results.
* Experienced in handling power supplies, electronic loads, data loggers, thermocouple installation and removal, IR cameras, air velocity sensors, and heat sink assemblies.
* Capable of setting up tests, system bring-up and troubleshooting issues with minimal assistance.
* Familiar with MDVT, EDVT, airflow, acoustics and environmental testing for networking products.

title: Digital Technology Senior Specialist - Data Operations Engineering
description:
**Digital Technology Senior Specialist - Data Operations Engineering**

**Would you like the opportunity to work in a global energy company?**

**Do you enjoy taking on challenging projects?**

The Data Engineering team helps solve our customers' toughest challenges; making flights safer, power cheaper, and oil & gas production safer for people and the environment by leveraging data and analytics. The Data Engineer will work with the team to create state-of-the-art data and analytics driven solutions, working across Baker Hughes to drive business analytics to a new level of predictive analytics while leveraging big data tools and technologies.

As Digital Technology Senior Specialist - Data Operations Engineering you will be Responsible for :

* Build a Databricks-based AI pipeline to ingest, process, and analyze enterprise data for predictive and intelligent outcomes.
* Ensure the architecture is optimized for performance and minimizes compute and storage costs through efficient workload management.
* Working knowledge of methods for parsing, formatting, & transforming data into units consistent with analytical needs.
* Demonstrates proficiency in implementation of logical/physical data models that support best practices.

title: Azure AI Engineer
description:
**We’re Pentland Brands:** a global family business behind some of the world’s most iconic active and lifestyle brands. We bring integrity, energy and ambition to our work, setting high standards and striving to deliver great outcomes without ego.

**Design cycling apparel built for movement, endurance and the ride ahead.**

At Pentland Brands, every role helps move our brands forward. Whether you’re supporting our people, improving our systems, growing our commercial performance, strengthening operations or shaping better ways of working, your impact reaches across a portfolio of iconic brands used by consumers around the world.

As our Azure AI Engineer, you'll partner with our brands globally and key functional areas to deliver technology that enables the business to realise its vision and strategy. You will work with our data platforms and tools to provide information that improves and enhances decision-making across the business.

**What you’ll be doing:**

* Design, develop, deploy and enhance production-grade AI solutions, including intelligent agents, generative AI applications and machine learning pipelines that solve real business problems at scale.
* Own the ongoing enhancement and operational support of AI agent solutions, including defect resolution, deployments, known limitations, backlog items and future improvements.
* Provide BAU support and enhancement delivery for production APIs on Azure, covering incident investigation, root-cause analysis, code or configuration changes, testing and deployment coordination.
* Provide Azure platform operational support across App Service, Azure SQL Database, Storage Accounts, managed identities, application settings, and related configuration and access requests.
* Administer and support Azure SFTP, including user and directory creation and maintenance, permissions, approved access changes, and connectivity or path troubleshooting.
* Support deployment and release processes, including environment configuration, pre-checks, post-deployment validation, rollback, and production support coordination.
* Monitor application and platform health using App Service logs and Application Insights; perform structured root-cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions for recurring issues.
* Apply strong software engineering practices and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders and dependent teams to translate requirements into reliable, maintainable solutions and measurable outcomes.

**What you’ll bring:**

**Experience:** 1–3 years of relevant experience in AI/ML engineering, Azure application development, or a closely related role.

**Must-have capabilities:**

* Strong proficiency in Python for AI/ML development, scripting, API development and automation, plus development experience with .NET and C# in the Azure ecosystem.
* Solid command of SQL for data extraction, transformation, analysis and pipeline support.
* Hands-on experience building applications with large language models, including prompt engineering, RAG architectures, embeddings and fine-tuning.
* Experience with at least one agent-building framework such as Google ADK, LangChain or LangGraph, including tool use, memory management and multi-step agent orchestration.
* Working experience with Azure deployment, compute, storage and cloud-native AI/ML services.
* Practical knowledge of building and training models using TensorFlow, PyTorch or Scikit-learn.

**Preferred capabilities:**

* Experience with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, Qdrant or FAISS for similarity search and RAG pipelines.
* Familiarity with MLOps and CI/CD tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow or Weights & Biases for experiment tracking, model versioning and deployment automation.
* Working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes for packaging and orchestrating AI workloads.
* Experience building and exposing AI services through REST or gRPC APIs using FastAPI, Flask or similar frameworks.
* Familiarity with Apache Airflow, Prefect or equivalent workflow orchestration tools.
* Proficiency with Git and collaborative development workflows.
* Strong analytical thinking, clear communication, the ability to work independently and across teams, and a proactive problem-solving mindset.

**Why Pentland Brands?**

Pentland Brands is the name behind some of the world’s best-known sport, outdoor and lifestyle brands, including Speedo, Berghaus, Canterbury, Endura, Ellesse, Kickers and Mitre.

We are a global family business with a clear purpose: pioneering brands that make life better. Across our teams, functions and locations, we work together to create products, experiences and partnerships that help people live more active, confident and positive lives.

Joining Pentland Brands means becoming part of a business where your work can have real reach, across multiple brands, markets, teams and disciplines. It is a place for people who want to contribute, collaborate, improve how things are done and help build the future of brands with heritage, ambition and global impact.

**Perks & Benefits**

Alongside a competitive salary and discretionary bonus, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your wellbeing, flexibility, and life outside work. This includes generous holiday allowance, hybrid and flexible working, employee transportation, pension and gratuity contributions, wellbeing support, medical, personal accident & term life insurance cover.

You can find full details of our benefits and perks on our UK Benefits page.

**The Interview Process**

We want our interview process to feel clear, straightforward, and supportive. If your experience and expectations look like a strong match for the role, here’s what you can expect next:

* **Talent Team Intro Call** - A 30-minute video call with our Talent Team to get to know each other, talk through the role and your experience, and answer any questions you have.
* **Experience Interview** - A more in-depth interview (usually online) with the hiring manager to explore your skills, experience and approach, and how these align with the role, our principles, and our ways of working.
* **Final Interview** - A final in-person interview at our office, focused on deeper discussion and practical application, giving you the chance to meet more of the team and see Pentland Brands in action.

* Experience building Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, and Apex, and working with Salesforce integration patterns (REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events).

description:

**Work Arrangement:**

This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the successful candidate is expected to report to the office four times per week or other frequency dictated by the business.

  

**The Role**

  

Global Manufacturing Engineering at GMTCI is a bridge between Global Manufacturing Plants & Global Product Engineering in getting the Product & Process Right. GMTCI’s strategy is to “Execute Design / Simulation / Virtual / Engineering Workshare for the Globe + Enable Factory for the Future”

This position of Manufacturing Data Analytics Engineer is a Mfg 4.0 initiative in ME Vehicle Systems Automation Group which is primarily responsible for applying Data Analytics techniques on GM manufacturing processes in GM manufacturing plants across the globe to solve complex manufacturing business problems with big data. In this position, the engineer supports critical business operations and decision making through creation domain data exploration, data processing pipeline, and business intelligence reports.

This is primarily a non-travel job. Business travel will be necessary on special requirements and will be for a short duration. Depending on the need, there will be an International Short-Term assignment for 6 months in the first year for training & development.

**What You’ll Do**

* Design, develop, and maintain full-stack manufacturing intelligence applications using modern frontend, backend, and database technologies
* Build intuitive React/TypeScript user experiences for manufacturing dashboards, workflow tools, operational insights, and engineering applications
* Develop scalable backend services and APIs using Python and FastAPI or comparable frameworks, with clear service boundaries, resilient error handling, and efficient request processing
* Integrate applications with manufacturing and enterprise systems, including MES, SCADA, PLC/controls data, historians, equipment interfaces, and event-driven data services
* Design and optimize PostgreSQL data models, queries, and data pipelines for production, quality, equipment, and process information
* Implement secure authentication, authorization, auditability, and data-access controls for applications used across GM manufacturing and engineering environments
* Deploy and operate applications across enterprise, cloud, and edge environments using Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD automation, and production monitoring
* Create automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests and establish engineering practices that improve application reliability, maintainability, and release quality
* Translate manufacturing and engineering problems into clear technical designs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and measurable product outcomes
* Collaborate with controls, manufacturing, quality, data science, cybersecurity, and IT teams to deliver solutions that improve visibility, productivity, quality, and decision-making
* Troubleshoot production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement performance and reliability improvements across the application stack
Document architecture, APIs, deployment procedures, operating standards, and support processes while contributing to a culture of continuous improvement.  

**Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications)**

  

* Bachelor's or higher degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience
* Ability to work effectively in both central engineering and plant environments, including time on the plant floor around operating equipment

* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building and supporting production full-stack applications
* 3+ years of experience delivering manufacturing intelligence, industrial software, or data-intensive enterprise applications across frontend, backend, and data layers
* Advanced TypeScript/JavaScript skills with React, including component architecture, state management, data visualization, responsive and accessible user interfaces, and frontend testing
* Strong Python development skills with FastAPI or comparable frameworks, including asynchronous programming, REST/OpenAPI service design, request validation, dependency management, and automated testing
* Advanced SQL and PostgreSQL skills, including relational data modeling, schema design, migrations, indexing, query and transaction performance, and data-quality controls
* Experience delivering manufacturing intelligence, industrial software, or data-intensive enterprise applications that connect operational data to business and engineering workflows
* Experience designing data pipelines and event-driven architectures for equipment telemetry, time-series data, production data, quality data, and manufacturing workflows
* Hands-on experience with Git, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD automation, environment configuration, and deployment practices for production applications

* Demonstrated intermediate-level proficiency with Microsoft Azure services and cloud-based application development.

* Experience implementing automated unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end testing, as well as observability using structured logging, metrics, tracing, health checks, and alerting
* Working knowledge of application and platform security, including OAuth/OIDC, role-based access control, secrets management, secure coding, vulnerability remediation, and least-privilege design
* Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot distributed systems, diagnose performance and reliability issues, and translate manufacturing requirements into maintainable technical designs and production releases
* Basic understanding of Databricks and its integration with other systems
* Working understanding of automotive manufacturing processes
Working knowledge of applying AI/ML techniques to manufacturing data, including integrating AI services and models into production applications, evaluating model outputs, using prompt engineering or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and monitoring AI system performance  

  

**What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)**

* Intermediate-to-expert proficiency with Databricks, including Spark and SQL data pipelines, Delta Lake, workflow orchestration, data-quality controls, and integration with manufacturing and enterprise systems
* Experience integrating OT and IT systems such as MES, SCADA, PLC/controls systems, OPC UA, MQTT, REST APIs, historians, and event or message-based platforms
* Experience working with manufacturing data models, time-series data, equipment telemetry, production genealogy, quality data, or process data
* Experience building data visualization and analytical user experiences for operational, engineering, quality, or maintenance users
* Experience with cloud-native and edge architectures, including Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, distributed systems, and disconnected or intermittently connected environments
* Knowledge of GM's controls standards, manufacturing technology standards, or comparable industrial automation and software integration standards
* Experience with event-driven architectures, streaming platforms, message queues, data historians, or real-time data processing
* Experience implementing observability practices, including structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, alerting, and service-level objectives
* Experience with automated security scanning, software supply-chain controls, vulnerability remediation, and cybersecurity practices for operational technology environments
* Experience leading technical design discussions, mentoring engineers, reviewing code, and establishing reusable software patterns across teams
Strong collaborative skills and the ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders in a fast-paced manufacturing environment

title: Identity & Access Management Engineer
description:
**About Marvell**

Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.

**Your Team, Your Impact**

Marvell is seeking a Senior level Identity & Access Management (IAM) Engineer with deep SailPoint Identity Security Cloud expertise to own and drive the technical direction of IAM across the enterprise.

**What You Can Expect**

* Drive the implementation of IAM technical architecture, with SailPoint Identity Security Cloud as the core governance platform, creating reference architectures aligned with security posture, and operational efficiency.
* Drive the integration of AI assisted IAM capabilities to improve decision quality, reduce manual effort, risk and champion use cases such as:
  + Intelligent access recommendations
  + Role and entitlement optimization
  + Risk based certification prioritization
  + Identity anomaly and outlier detection
* Make high impact technical decisions in areas of ambiguity, balancing risk, and scale.
* Lead the design and evolution of SailPoint ISC implementations, including identity lifecycle automation, access governance, role models, certifications, and integrations.
* Set engineering standards for rules, transforms, workflows, REST/SCIM integrations, and connector patterns.
* Drive reliability and scale of JML processes, ensuring strong controls, observability, and operational resilience.
* Architect and mature RBAC and entitlement-based governance models, including SoD and policy-driven access controls.
* Partner with Security teams to ensure IAM capabilities support audit readiness and compliance outcomes without introducing friction.
* Evaluate emerging vendor capabilities and influence platform adoption decisions with a long-term, architectural mindset.
* Serve as a trusted technical partner to application teams, infrastructure, security leadership, and audit stakeholders.
* Influence IAM adoption patterns across engineering teams without direct authority.

**What We're Looking For**

The ideal candidate will focus on defining architecture and influencing cross functional teams. The individual will serve as an IAM subject matter expert, responsible for evolving Marvell’s IAM capabilities toward a scalable, intelligent, and automation first identity platform, including the thoughtful adoption of AI driven IAM capabilities.

**Technical Competencies**

* Expert level hands-on experience with SailPoint Identity Security Cloud, including architecture, rules, workflows, transforms, roles, and certifications.
* Deep understanding of enterprise identity lifecycle management and HR driven provisioning.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, including authentication, Conditional Access, and identity governance integration points.
* Solid foundation in Active Directory architecture, group strategy, and directory security.
* Strong grasp of IGA concepts (RBAC, SoD, least privilege) and their real-world tradeoffs.
* Automation and scripting experience (PowerShell, APIs, or equivalent).
* Knowledge of Zero Trust and IAM security best practices.
* Experience with privileged access workflows preferred.

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years of progressive IAM experience, with demonstrated ownership of complex SailPoint environments.
* Proven experience operating at a senior level, influencing architecture and outcomes beyond a single team.
* SailPoint or IAM certification preferred.
* Strong ability to communicate technical decisions and tradeoffs across engineering and senior leadership audiences.

This role is eligible to participate in Marvell's bonus and equity plans, including a new hire equity grant and annual equity refreshers, ensuring you are rewarded for your contributions and remain invested in the company's long-term success.

**Additional Compensation and Benefit Elements**

With competitive compensation and great benefits, you will enjoy our workstyle within an environment of shared collaboration, transparency, and inclusivity. We’re dedicated to giving our people the tools and resources they need to succeed in doing work that matters, and to grow and develop with us. For additional information on what it’s like to work at Marvell, visit our Careers page.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.

These tools must not be used to record, assist with, or enhance responses in any way. Use of AI tools without prior instruction from the interviewer will result in disqualification from the hiring process.

As such, applicants must be eligible to access export-controlled information as defined under applicable law. title: AI Engineer
description:

The ideal candidate will have strong programming skills in Python, experience building and integrating AI models, and the ability to develop scalable AI applications using modern frameworks, cloud platforms, and data technologies.

* Work with structured and unstructured datasets for data preparation, feature engineering, model training, and evaluation.
* Develop AI services and APIs using Python frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
* Evaluate, fine-tune, and optimise AI models for accuracy, performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.

* Strong proficiency in Python programming and software development fundamentals.
* Hands-on experience with Machine Learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Scikit-learn.
* Strong understanding of Machine Learning algorithms, model evaluation, feature engineering, and statistical concepts.
* Experience developing Generative AI applications using LLMs.

* Experience with Hugging Face Transformers, OpenAI-compatible APIs, or other LLM platforms.
* Understanding of REST APIs, microservices, and application integration.
* Experience working with SQL/NoSQL databases and data processing pipelines.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.

* Experience developing AI agents and multi-step AI workflows.
* Knowledge of Kubernetes, distributed computing, and scalable cloud architectures.
* Experience deploying AI solutions in production with measurable business outcomes.

Key Competencies

* AI/ML model development and deployment
* Generative AI and LLM application development
* Python programming and API development
* Data processing and model evaluation
* AI system integration and optimisation
* Production deployment and monitoring
* Technical problem-solving and collaboration

This role participates in both Level 1 (L1) and Level 2 (L2) support activities based on business need, skill, access, and incident priority. The role also participates in the 24/7 on-call rotation and responds to assigned incidents within applicable service-level targets and escalation procedures.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Customer Support and Incident Management**
--------------------------------------------

* Receive, clarify, categorize, and troubleshoot customer requests through approved support channels.
* Perform L1 triage and resolve common L1 and L2 issues using documented procedures, known solutions, and guidance from senior engineers.
* Collect complete diagnostic information, reproduce issues when feasible, and escalate with a clear problem statement, evidence, customer impact, and actions already attempted.
* Maintain accurate ticket status, customer communications, time entries, resolution details, and handoff notes.

**Technical Investigation**
---------------------------

* Use foundational skills in SQL, Windows/Linux, application logs, networking concepts, and cloud services to investigate incidents.

title: AI Engineer, Harness & Eval
description:
You'll be one of the first engineers in NAVEX's AI Centre of Excellence, a new function with a company-wide mandate to put AI into how the business runs. We build AI for business operations and internal agentic products.
  
You'll build production agents and, more importantly, the harness around them: the evals, tracing and guardrails that tell us an agent works before a user finds out it doesn't. Some agents you'll build from scratch. Others were built by external partners and are moving in-house. You'll own both.
  
At NAVEX, we’re transforming the world-making it safer, more ethical, and ensuring every voice is heard. That’s real impact.
  
Our high-performance culture is driven by our values. We move with speed, passion and purpose - as one team. We are bold in our ideas, accountable in our actions, and committed to doing the right things right.
  
You’ll thrive in this hybrid role surrounded by an engaged, collaborative team deeply committed to innovation, speed, and measurable outcomes. Join us and help shape what’s next!
  
  
**What you’ll get:**  

* Meaningful Purpose. Your work helps organizations operate with integrity and protect their people-at a scale few companies can match.
* High-Performance Environment. We move with urgency, set ambitious goals, and expect excellence. You’ll be trusted with real ownership and supported to do the best work of your career.
* Candid, Supportive Culture. We communicate openly, challenge ideas- not people-and value teammates who embrace bold thinking and continuous improvement.
* Growth That Matters. You can count on authentic feedback, strong accountability, and leaders invested in your success so you can achieve real growth.
* Rewards for Results. We provide clear, competitive compensation designed to recognize measurable outcomes and real impact.

**What you’ll do:**  

* Build and ship agents for business operations and internal products. End to end: retrieval, tool use, orchestration, state, and handoffs to human
* Build MCP servers and tool integrations that give agents safe, reliable access to company systems and data
* Design the eval harness. Golden sets, regression suites, LLM-as-judge where it earns its place, human review loops. Every change ships with evidence that it made things better
* Instrument agents in production. Tracing, failure taxonomies, cost and latency tracking. When something degrades, you find out first and know why
* Take over agents built by external partners. Read the code, find where it breaks, add the evals and observability it shipped without
* Hold a verification bar. In a compliance company, an answer we can't source or explain doesn't ship

**What you’ll bring:**  

* 3+ years of AI engineering experience, most of it building LLM systems that real users depend on
* Hands-on experience building with agentic harnesses such as Claude Code, Codex, or similar
* You've built MCP servers, eval harnesses or LLM Systems, not just used them and can explain how you knew a change was an improvement
* You've owned a system that degraded in production and diagnosed why, and can walk us through it
* Strong Python. Comfortable with at least one agent framework, and willing to go below it when it gets in the way
* Experience deploying on a major cloud provider: AWS, GCP or Azure
* You've shipped end-to-end and own outcomes, not just tasks
* You can take a non-technical team's workflow and turn it into a working system
* Bonus points for:
* Building RAG over messy enterprise documents—proposals, contracts and policies
* Working with AWS Bedrock or inside VPC-constrained enterprise environments
* Building in regulated or compliance-heavy domains
* Sharing your work through writing, talks or open source
* Culture Agility. Comfort working in a fast-paced, candid environment that values innovation, healthy debate, and follow-through
* Fuel performance and outcomes. Leverage your job competencies and champion NAVEX’s core values

**Our side of the deal:**  

* We’ll be clear, we’ll move fast, and we’ll invest in your success. You deserve to be supported, challenged, and rewarded for the impact you make—and we commit to doing that every step of the way.
* The starting pay for this role is 3,000,000 INR with 10% MBO. Discover how you can grow, lead, and make an impact by visiting our career page to learn more. NAVEX is an equal opportunity employer committed to including individuals of all backgrounds, including those with disabilities and veteran status.

* Mentor junior engineers and promote best practices within the team

title: Senior Linux Administrator
description:
NVIDIA is looking for an exceptional engineer to grow and thrive alongside our Infrastructure team that designs, evaluates, and optimizes the compute inrastructure powering NVIDIA's next-generation silicon design and AI

workloads.You will own the operational health, efficiency and observability of a large Linux compute farm serving NVIDIA's VLSI design teams  
  
**What you'll be doing:**

* In this position, you will own the operational health, efficiency and observability of a large Linux compute farm serving NVIDIA's VLSI design teams, and be the person who can say where the time and the capacity are actually going.
* Profile and debug at the system level - kernel, filesystem, memory and I/O behaviour - when workloads are slow, and turn findings into fixes rather than tickets.
* Drive compute efficiency: memory request-versus-usage accuracy, CPU waste from idle and over-provisioned jobs, and the prediction models behind resource requests.
* Build the observability layer for the farm - telemetry pipelines, metrics and dashboards that make capacity, utilisation and job behaviour visible to engineers and to leadership - and own licence monitoring and expiry alerting across the EDA tool estate.
* This is a hands-on technical role. Day-to-day farm operations and live triage are a core part of it, and you will work directly with the heaviest users on their workload behaviour, since most efficiency gains come from a small number of workflows.

**What we need to see:**

* B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years in Linux systems administration or infrastructure operations at scale.
* Deep Linux systems and kernel-level expertise - comfortable with perf, eBPF/bpftrace, strace, cgroups, NUMA, memory management, scheduler behaviour and I/O subsystems, and able to use them to find root cause rather than guess at it.
* Demonstrated experience diagnosing and fixing performance problems on large multi-user compute systems.
* Strong NFS and distributed filesystem troubleshooting: metadata versus data path, client behaviour, mount and latency issues.
* Hands-on experience building observability - time-series metrics, log and telemetry pipelines, and dashboards (Prometheus/Grafana, Elastic, or equivalent) - plus strong Python for analysis and automation.
* Familiarity with batch schedulers (LSF, Slurm, or equivalent) and job resource accounting, and a genuine appetite for operational work. Semiconductor/EDA or HPC background is a plus.

description:

------------

Intuit's Data, Growth, & Experiences (DGX) organization is building the system of intelligence that powers every AI-driven customer experience across TurboTax, QuickBooks, Credit Karma, and Mailchimp. As a Principal TPM on this team, you will sit at the intersection of enterprise data infrastructure and marketing technology — orchestrating the programs that enable 100M+ customers to experience Intuit as one seamlessly intelligent platform.  
This is a strategic leadership position for a technical operator who understands data platforms and MarTech ecosystems deeply, moves with urgency, and earns the trust of both engineers and executives. You will drive programs that define how Intuit collects, manages, and activates data to deliver personalised, agentic, done-for-you financial experiences at scale.

**Responsibilities**

Lead Platform Programs at Enterprise Scale

* Own end-to-end delivery of a portfolio of strategic programs spanning data infrastructure (lakehouse, streaming, IDX), MarTech platforms (CDP, campaign orchestration, personalization), and AI-powered experimentation
* Drive program strategy, architecture alignment, milestone tracking, risk mitigation, and stakeholder communication from initiation through business outcome realization
* Maintain unwavering focus on outcomes — not just delivery milestones — translating engineering execution into measurable business impact

Operate at VP Level with Executive Authority

* Partner directly with VP and Director-level leaders across DGX to shape investment priorities, resolve organizational dependencies, and hold delivery commitments at scale
* Serve as the connective tissue between engineering, product management, data science, marketing, and business stakeholders — enabling decisions that would otherwise stall in silos
* Drive regular executive readouts, program reviews, and async communication that give senior leadership real-time visibility into portfolio health and emerging risks

Build the DGX Program Operating Model

* Define and continuously evolve the TPM frameworks, program health metrics, operating cadences, and delivery standards for the DGX organization
* Establish portfolio visibility practices — dependency maps, risk registers, milestone dashboards — that enable a high say-do ratio across all DGX programs

* Model what it means to be an AI-first builder: demonstrate and teach how LLMs, automation, and intelligent tooling can make the entire team faster and sharper

Develop the TPM Community

* Coach and mentor program managers across DGX, raising the technical and strategic capabilities of the team
* Define best practices, playbooks, and frameworks that scale the TPM discipline and elevate program management standards across the broader Intuit TPM community
* Act as a trusted advisor to product and engineering leaders — someone who is brought in early on hard problems because of the clarity, rigor, and influence you bring

**Qualifications**

Experience & Track Record

* 12+ years of Technical Program Management experience in large-scale, matrixed technology organizations
* Demonstrated history of delivering enterprise data platform programs — data warehouses, lakehouses, event streaming pipelines, data mesh architectures, or large-scale API platforms
* Direct experience with MarTech ecosystems — CDPs (e.g., Segment, Salesforce, Adobe), campaign orchestration platforms, personalisation engines, A/B experimentation infrastructure, or growth technology
* Proven ability to influence VP- and Director-level stakeholders on strategic investment decisions and organizational priorities

Technical Depth

* Strong conceptual and applied understanding of modern cloud data architectures: data lakehouses (Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery), event streaming (Kafka, Flink), data mesh or data fabric patterns, and API design
* Fluent in the MarTech stack: understands how CDPs, DMPs, campaign tools, measurement frameworks, and personalization engines interconnect to create unified customer data activation
* Comfortable leading architectural design reviews, evaluating technical trade-offs, and representing engineering complexity in executive narratives
* Conversant in AI/ML concepts as applied to customer data: feature pipelines, model serving, real-time inference, experimentation, and responsible AI practices

Strategic & Analytical Mindset

* Uses data as a first-class tool for program management: monitors leading and lagging indicators, constructs health dashboards, and makes evidence-based course corrections
* Anticipates risks before they materialize; designs mitigation strategies that address root cause, not just symptoms
* Sees across organizational boundaries — identifies systemic dependencies, cross-team sequencing risks, and alignment gaps that others miss

Communication & Influence

* Exceptional written and verbal communicator; able to distill highly technical and complex program status into clear, executive-ready narrative
* Skilled navigator of ambiguity, competing priorities, and organizational tension — influences outcomes without relying on authority
* Builds trust rapidly across engineering, product, data, design, and business functions through credibility, follow-through, and genuine intellectual curiosity

Education

* BS or MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline — or equivalent practical experience
* PMP, SAFe, or Agile/Scrum certifications are a plus; demonstrated equivalent mastery is equally valued

NICE TO HAVE

* Prior experience at a company with significant MarTech or data platform infrastructure at consumer scale (e.g., Google, Meta, Adobe, Salesforce, Uber, Airbnb, Netflix, Amazon, Intuit)
* Background in financial technology, SaaS, or consumer platforms with 50M+ active users
* Hands-on experience with GenAI application development, LLM platform programs, or agentic AI system delivery
* Familiarity with privacy-by-design frameworks, consent management platforms, or data governance programs at enterprise scale

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit. Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

We enable healthcare organizations to be future ready and our customer obsession is our driving force. We ensure that our customers achieve what they truly want. We are bold in our actions, nimble in our decision-making, and industrious in the way we work.

**Job Description**

We are looking for a highly skilled and forward-thinking AI Solutions Architect to lead the design, development, and deployment of enterprise-grade AI solutions powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). This role demands hands on expertise in designing scalable AI architectures, integrating cutting-edge tools, and ensuring safety, observability, and performance at scale. This role also requires collaboration with engineering leads to drive AI innovation/ discussion, drive technical decisions, ensure delivery ownerships and include Gen AI capabilities in the existing product roadmaps/ frameworks.

The ideal candidate brings strong experience in Software engineering, AI/ML systems, system/ solution engineering, distributed architecture, and platform design, along with recent hands-on work in Generative AI, multi-agent systems, LAG/RAG pipelines, and AI governance. You should be equally comfortable reviewing legacy software architectures, mentoring engineers, working with cross-functional stakeholders, and driving production readiness of AI systems.

Key Responsibilities :-

AI Platform Architecture: Design and own the end-to-end architecture for enterprise AI systems spanning LLM orchestration, multi-agent workflows, RAG pipelines, vector databases, LLM gateways, and API layers. Define reference architectures, design patterns (ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, Tool-Use), and enforce architectural standards through Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).

Agentic AI & Multi-Agent Systems: Architect and implement production multi-agent systems with specialized agents (content generation, compliance auditing, data retrieval, orchestration), inter-agent communication protocols, tool/function calling frameworks, plugin registries, and memory management (conversation buffers, working memory, long-term vector stores). Design human-in-the-loop checkpoints, fallback chains, and graceful degradation patterns.

Production RAG Systems: Design production-grade RAG pipelines including document ingestion (PDF, DOCX, HTML with tables, images, multi-column layouts), chunking strategies (recursive, semantic, document-structure-aware, parent-child), hybrid retrieval (semantic + BM25 + metadata filtering), re-ranking, query analysis/rewriting, citation enforcement, and hallucination detection.

LLM Strategy & Model Routing: Define multi-provider LLM strategies across Claude (Anthropic), GPT-4o (OpenAI), Gemini (Google), and open-source models (Llama, Mistral). Architect intelligent model routing that optimizes for cost, latency, and capability. Evaluate and recommend models for specific use cases based on capability fit, context window, compliance, and deployment constraints.

LLMOps & AgentOps: Build CI/CD pipelines for AI systems prompt versioning and regression testing, automated evaluation suites (RAGAS, LLM-as-Judge), model A/B testing, and staged rollouts. Design observability infrastructure with full execution tracing, token tracking, cost attribution, latency SLAs, and quality dashboards using AgentOps, LangSmith, Langfuse or OpenTelemetry.

Evaluation & Quality Assurance: Design multi-layered evaluation frameworks combining automated metrics (RAGAS, BLEU, ROUGE), LLM-as-Judge pipelines with bias mitigation, embedding-based similarity, and domain-expert human review. Build and maintain golden test datasets (500+ curated QA pairs). Define monitoring for retrieval health, hallucination rates, empty retrieval rates, and user satisfaction.

Explainable AI (XAI): Implement explainability at multiple levels input attribution (RAG citations with chunk-level source mapping), reasoning traces (structured Chain-of-Thought with audit trails), confidence calibration, uncertainty quantification, and contrastive explanations. Produce model cards, data sheets, and system documentation for regulatory compliance.

Responsible AI & Governance: Establish and lead the Responsible AI program including guardrail architecture (input/processing/output guardrails with declarative configuration), bias detection and fairness evaluation pipelines, red-teaming exercises (prompt injection, data poisoning, adversarial attacks), AI security measures, PII redaction, privacy-by-design, and regulatory compliance (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, FDA AI/ML guidance, GDPR/CCPA).

Strategic Leadership: Collaborate with Engineering, Product, Business, Legal, and Compliance stakeholders to translate requirements into AI roadmaps. Mentor a team of 20+ engineers through design reviews, technical coaching, and career development. Drive build-vs-buy-vs-open-source decisions and present technical strategy to executive leadership.

Technical Skills :-

Languages & Frameworks: Expert Python; proficient JavaScript/TypeScript. FastAPI, Flask, or Django for backend APIs. ReactJS or Streamlit for AI interfaces.

LLM & Agent Frameworks: Microsoft Agent framework, AutoGen, LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, Strands Agents, Semantic Kernel. Deep knowledge of ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, and Tool-Use orchestration patterns.

Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS (Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, S3, DynamoDB) and/or Azure (Azure OpenAI, AI Studio, Cognitive Services). Multi-cloud experience preferred.

Vector Databases: Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, pgvector, ChromaDB, or Milvus in production environments.

Document Processing: Azure Document Intelligence, PyMuPDF, Unstructured.io, LlamaParse. Experience with tables, images, and complex PDF/DOCX extraction.

Data & Storage: MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch. Data modeling for AI-driven applications.

Observability & MLOps: AgentOps, LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, OpenTelemetry, Weights & Biases. CI/CD for AI (GitHub Actions, Jenkins).

LLM Gateway: LiteLLM, Portkey, or custom gateway development for multi-model routing, rate limiting, and cost tracking

Key Competencies :-

Strong architectural thinking with the ability to balance scalability, simplicity, cost, speed, and risk.

Strong people leadership and mentoring capability.

Ability to drive delivery while maintaining technical quality.

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Strong problem-solving and decision-making ability in ambiguous environments.

High ownership mindset with focus on business impact and production outcomes.

Commitment to responsible, secure, and ethical AI adoption.

Education :-

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science/ Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field.

Ph.D./ Publications or contributions to AI projects/ international journals is a plus

**Qualifications**

AI - Data Science BE/ Btech/ BCA/ Mtech / MBA )

**Additional Information**

This position is required to be filled urgently for Content Supply BU. Would request for quick action.

title: Design Verification Engineer, Silicon Engineering
description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4 years of experience verifying digital logic at RTL using System Verilog for FPGAs and ASICs.
* Experience with UVM Testbenches/environments.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, with an emphasis on computer architecture.
* Expertise in creating/using verification components and environments in UVM methodology at IP or Subsystem level.
* Experience with image processing, computer vision or machine learning IPs.
* Experience with AMBA(APB/AXI/ACE) or other standard protocols.
* Familiarity with CPU, GPU or other compute/ML architectures.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work with cross-functional teams.

**About the job**
-----------------

Be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's direct-to-consumer products. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide. Your expertise will shape the next generation of hardware experiences, delivering unparalleled performance, efficiency, and integration.

As an ASIC Design Verification Engineer on the Silicon team, you will verify next-generation custom silicon accelerators and SoCs, build advanced Universal Verification Methodology (UVM) test environments, and collaborate across design, architecture, and emulation teams to deliver production-quality silicon.

  
The Platforms and Devices team encompasses Google's various computing software platforms across environments (desktop, mobile, applications), as well as our first party devices and services that combine the best of Google AI, software, and hardware. Teams across this area research, design, and develop new technologies to make our user's interaction with computing faster and more seamless, building innovative experiences for our users around the world.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Create and improve constrained-random verification environments using SystemVerilog and UVM. Use SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA) and formal tools for formal verification.
* Perform power-aware simulations and formal verification to validate power management features like clock gating, power gating, and Dynamic Voltage and Frequency Scaling (DVFS). Develop and implement power-aware test cases, including stress and corner-case scenarios, for robust power integrity.
* Develop and execute coverage-driven verification plans to ensure comprehensive coverage of ASIC designs. Collaborate with design engineers to resolve coverage issues and improve design quality.
* Plan the verification of complex digital design blocks by understanding design specifications and collaborating with design engineers to identify key verification scenarios.

* Reduce time to market and improve PPA through deployment of Artificial Intelligence (AI) physical design tools and workflows.

Overview:
**Connecting clients to markets – and talent to opportunity.**  

  

With 5,400\+ employees and over 80,000 institutional, commercial, and payments clients, we operate from more than 80 offices spread across six continents. As a Fortune 100, Nasdaq\-listed provider, we connect clients to the global markets – focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world\-class products and services to all types of investors.  

  

Whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, StoneX Group is made up of four business segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth.

 **Corporate:** Engage in a deep variety of business\-critical activities that keep our company running efficiently. From strategic marketing and financial management to human resources and operational oversight, you’ll have the opportunity to optimize processes and implement game\-changing policies.


Responsibilities:
**Job Purpose:**The ITOC Team Leader provides technical leadership for a 24x7x365 IT Operations Center responsible for monitoring, triage, incident coordination, escalation, communication and operational stability across network, infrastructure, cloud, security and business application environments. The role acts as the first point of technical command during production issues, drives timely restoration, ensures accurate stakeholder communication, maintains strong operational discipline and supports continual improvement through automation, runbook maturity, monitoring quality and service reliability metrics.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* **24x7 Monitoring \& Event Response:** Lead real\-time monitoring of critical IT services, infrastructure, circuits, servers, storage, virtualization, cloud platforms, security alerts and business applications.
* **Incident Command \& Coordination:** Act as shift\-level incident lead for major alerts or outages, coordinate technical bridges, assign investigation actions, track progress and drive issues toward restoration.
* **Technical Triage \& Troubleshooting:** Perform initial and advanced triage across network, Windows/Linux, virtualization, database, middleware, backup, storage and application layers before escalation.
* **Escalation Ownership:** Engage appropriate Level 2/Level 3 teams, vendors, exchanges, network providers and service owners, while continuing to own the incident until resolution or clear handover.
* **Business \& Stakeholder Communication:** Prepare clear operational updates, outage notifications, awareness messages and resolved communications for service owners, Service Desk and impacted business groups.
* **Shift Leadership \& Handover Quality:** Manage shift priorities, ensure clean shift handovers, maintain situational awareness of active incidents, planned maintenance, pending escalations and operational risks.
* **Runbook \& SOP Management:** Create, review and improve operational runbooks, escalation matrices, alert response procedures and knowledge articles to improve consistency across shifts.
* **Post\-Incident Review Support:** Contribute to incident timelines, impact summaries, root\-cause follow\-up, corrective actions and problem\-management tracking.
* **Operational Reporting \& Metrics:** Track and report key metrics such as alert volumes, incident trends, SLA adherence, MTTA, MTTR, recurring issues, handover quality and automation opportunities.
* **Monitoring Quality \& Alert Hygiene:** Identify noisy, duplicate or low\-value alerts and work with engineering teams to improve thresholds, coverage, routing and actionable alert design.
* **Automation \& Continuous Improvement:** Identify repetitive operational tasks suitable for automation using scripts, APIs, workflows or AI\-assisted tooling; support safe automation adoption with proper controls.
* **Team Mentoring \& KT:** Coach junior ITOC engineers, support onboarding, conduct knowledge\-transfer sessions and promote consistent troubleshooting and communication standards.
* **Change \& Maintenance Support:** Monitor planned changes, validate post\-change service health, support maintenance windows and raise concerns when service risk is observed.
* **Compliance \& Documentation Discipline:** Ensure incidents, escalations, evidence, actions and communications are documented accurately in tickets according to defined policies and SOPs.


Qualifications:
**Experience:** 7\-10 years in ITOC/NOC/SOC, infrastructure operations, network operations, application operations or enterprise monitoring.

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering or equivalent practical experience.
* **Technical Skills:** ITIL Foundation or higher; CCNA/CCNP; Good understanding of BGP; VMware; Linux/Windows administration certifications, F5 BIG\-IP
* **Tools \-** Datadog, servicenow, solarwinds
* **Domain Exposure:** Experience in financial services, regulated environments, global operations, follow\-the\-sun support and 24x7 support if required.

**Working Environment:**

4 days in office per week

title: Sr. Staff Engineer – Power Lead, Systems Architecture
description:
**Company:**
------------

Qualcomm India Private Limited
**Job Area:**
-------------

Engineering Group, Engineering Group \> Systems Engineering
**General Summary:**

We are seeking a Sr. Staff **Power Lead – Systems Architecture** to lead system\-level power architecture, analysis, modeling, projection, optimization, and issue closure for complex SoCs and platforms. This is a **systems architecture role** , not a narrowly scoped circuit\-power or physical\-design position.


The successful candidate will define and assess system power states, power islands, operating points, workload scenarios, data movement, shared\-resource policies, and power\-performance\-thermal trade\-offs. The role will establish traceability from product use cases and architecture assumptions through pre\-silicon estimates, design evidence, post\-silicon measurements, correlation, and next\-generation improvements.


**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead system power architecture for target SoCs and platforms from concept development through architecture freeze, design convergence, pre\-silicon readiness, post\-silicon characterization, and learning closure.
* Translate product requirements, use cases, workload behavior, concurrency, duty cycles, thermal constraints, and performance KPIs into system\-level power requirements and architecture decisions.
* Define and analyze system power states, power islands, retention strategies, clock\- and power\-gating behavior, wake/sleep flows, operating points, DVFS policies, and cross\-IP power\-management interactions.
* Establish top\-down system power budgets and projections and work with IP teams to decompose targets, assumptions, modes, activity profiles, and optimization requirements.
* Develop or guide workload\-driven analytical, simulation, empirical, or hybrid models for power and performance projection.
* Evaluate architectural options across power, performance, thermal behavior, area, latency, responsiveness, complexity, risk, and user\-experience objectives.
* Perform workload, use\-case, concurrency, utilization, traffic, and data\-movement analysis to identify system\-level optimization opportunities.
* Drive cross\-IP power optimization involving compute, memory, interconnect, multimedia, connectivity, peripherals, system infrastructure, firmware, and software policies.
* Track gaps between targets and projections; lead technical investigations, root\-cause analysis, mitigation planning, risk assessment, and issue closure.
* Integrate IP\-level models and implementation evidence into coherent system projections while making assumptions, model fidelity, uncertainty, and confidence ranges explicit.
* Define architecture validation and measurement requirements so that pre\-silicon hypotheses can be verified on emulation, prototypes, boards, and production silicon.
* Correlate pre\-silicon models and estimates with post\-silicon rail, workload, telemetry, and performance measurements; explain material variances and feed calibrated models and architecture actions into subsequent products.
* Partner with SoC architecture, performance/modeling, IP architecture, RTL design, DV, physical design, firmware, software, thermal, validation, lab, and silicon teams.
* Communicate system power status, trade\-offs, risks, recommendations, and closure plans to technical and program stakeholders.
* Develop reusable power\-architecture methods, workload definitions, model standards, projection practices, dashboards, and review criteria.

**Minimum/Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field and **10\+ years** of Systems Engineering, SoC Architecture, Power Architecture, Performance/Power Analysis, or related experience; **or**
* Master’s degree in a related field and **8\+ years** of relevant experience; **or**
* PhD in a related field and **5\+ years** of relevant experience.
* Approximately **10\+ years of relevant industry experience is preferred** .
* Strong understanding of SoC and computer architecture, including compute subsystems, memory hierarchy, interconnects, system infrastructure, I/O, clock/reset, and HW/SW interaction.
* Experience in system power architecture, workload\-based power analysis, power\-performance analysis, system modeling, projection, optimization, or post\-silicon power characterization.
* Ability to reason about dynamic and leakage power, operating modes, utilization, duty cycle, voltage/frequency operating points, concurrency, and thermal or sustained\-performance effects.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross\-functional technical investigations and convert analysis into architecture or optimization decisions.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, technical\-communication, and stakeholder\-leadership skills.

**Preferred Qualifications and Domain Expertise**

* Experience defining SoC or subsystem power states, islands, low\-power modes, sleep/idle behavior, wake\-up paths, retention, power gating, clock gating, or DVFS.
* Experience with representative CPU, GPU, DSP, NPU/AI, memory, interconnect, multimedia, connectivity, peripheral, or full\-platform workloads.
* Hands\-on experience with power/performance modeling, sensitivity analysis, projection, workload characterization, trace analysis, scripting, or large\-data analysis.
* Experience correlating architecture models and pre\-silicon estimates with post\-silicon measurements and driving variance root cause and model calibration.
* Familiarity with rail\-level power measurements, silicon telemetry, performance counters, profiling, lab measurement methods, board bring\-up, or system debugging.
* Working knowledge of RTL/gate\-level power inputs, activity factors, leakage/dynamic splits, corners, implementation data, or power\-estimation tools.
* Awareness of UPF/CPF, power\-domain crossings, isolation, level shifting, retention, structural low\-power verification, synthesis, timing, or physical\-design power considerations.
* Understanding of PMICs, regulators, power rails, PDN/power\-grid considerations, thermal management, and their relationship to SoC operating policy.
* Familiarity with Linux/Android, firmware, device drivers, system traces, power\-management software, or Python/shell\-based automation.
* Prior SoC architecture, subsystem architecture, IP microarchitecture, design, validation, or silicon\-debug experience.
* Demonstrated technical leadership across distributed teams, including the ability to align stakeholders and influence decisions without direct authority.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 6\+ years of Systems Engineering or related work experience.

OR
  

Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 5\+ years of Systems Engineering or related work experience.
